Ngenxa yalokhu kugxekwa usefuna ukudatshukelwa kube sengathi ubehlukumezekile enkampanini kaSithole kube kungenjalo. Lezinto azishoyo ukuthi inkampani yambopha yindlela yokuzama ukungcolisa igama lami nelikaSithole okuyithina esimakhile emculweni. Ngisho ekhuluma kwabezindaba akawabali amagama ethu njengabantu abamsizile emculweni ngoba ulwa nathi,” kusho uNgane.Uthe nokuthi ubesephila ngokuphuza utshwala abebuthengelwa ngabantu kungamanga aluhlaza.“Kubangani bakhe uZakwe akekho obenemali ngaphandle kwakhe. Uyena obethengela abantu utshwala. Kukhona abanye engike ngixoxe nabo abangitshela ukuthi wabafaka nasezidakamizweni ngoba kunguyena obethenga yonke into uma enabo,” kuqhuba uNgane.Ethintwa uZakwe ushaye ungqimphothwe ngokuthi ubenenkinga yokuboshwa yinkampani abekuyona.“Engangizama ukukuchaza ukuthi ngibe nengcindezi sengiphumile enkampanini ngingazi ukuthi ikusasa lingiphatheleni emculweni. Okokuthi yimina obethengela abantu utshwala ngicabanga ukuthi naye uNgane akanalo iqiniso lalokho ngoba ubejwayele ukungifica nginezinsizwa ebesihlala nazo siphuza. Okusho ukuthi yena ubezitshela ukuthi yimina othenge utshwala,” kusho uZakwe.Uthe kungenzeka ukuthi uNgane usenesilonda sokuthi washiya enkampanini usafisa abuye.Ngezinsolo zezidakamizwa, uthe ubengazi ukuthi isimo sesibi kangaka phakathi kwakhe noNgane ukuthi angaze athi ubethengela abantu izidakamizwa, athi akulona iqiniso.Odabeni olwedlule uZakwe uveze ukuthi izinkinga enkampanini iNative Rhythms zenze waze washiya nenkampani ayisungula noNgane, iSphethu Entertainment.UNgane uthe uZakwe wayengasayinile njengomculi kwiSphethu kodwa wayengumphathi. Uthe ngesikhathi ehamba wabhala incwadi esho ukuthi uyayiyeka inkampani ngoba uyabambezeleka emculweni okuyinto engahlangene nezinkinga athi ubenazo. text: UVALE amasango kamasipala, izolo umphakathi waseMooi River othi awusayifuni imeya yawo othi ayizi uma uyibizela emihlanganweni kodwa iphendula ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Lo mphakathi obukhala ngokuthi iMeya kaMasipala iMpofana, uMnuz Xolani Duma iqasha abangani bayo ezikhaleni zemisebenzi ezikhangisiwe, uthi kunomyalezo osabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana okuthiwa ubhalwe ngothile obebonga umsebenzi ekubeni umphakathi usaqhubeka nokuletha ama-CV awo ezikhaleni ezingu-13 zamaGeneral Worker ezikhangisiwe kodwa kube usuku lokuvalwa kokufakwa kwezicelo kungoLwesithathu.Umphakathi okuthiwa ubuholwa yintsha kuthiwa ugasele kwamasipala ngoLwesibili wavala amasango uthi ufuna ukuthi imeya izophendula ngalokhu okubone kuFacebook, iphinde ichaze ukuthi yini eyenze ukuthi lezi zikhala zincishiswe ngoba phambilini bezingu-50. Abantu bathi kwasha amahhovisi akwandabazabantu kulo masipala abantu sebezifakile izicelo zomsebenzi, kwase kuthiwa zizobuye zivulwe kabusha kodwa sezibuya sezingaphansi kwesibalo esasikhishwe.Abasolwa ngokuthi bahola lo mkhankaso wokuvala umasipala baboshiwe ngalo uLwesibili ntambama besolwa ngokulimaza impahla kamasipala, badedelwa ngesexwayiso izoloUMYALEZO okuthiwa ubuthunyelelwe imeya kaMasipala waseMpofana osatshalaliswe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, oholele ekutheni umphakathi uvale umasipalaAbangaboshwanga babuyele kuwo lo masipala ekuseni, izolo baphinde bavala umasipala.Elinye ilunga lomphakathi elingathandanga ukudalulwa lithe: “Zishonephi izikhala ezingu-37, njengoba sekukhangiswe ezingu-13? Uneminyaka emithathu ehleli esihlalweni sobumeya kodwa akezi emhlanganweni uma simbiza, ugijima ayobhala kuFacebook.”UDuma akatholakalanga ocingweni lwakhe kodwa kwi-akhawunti kaFacebook okuthiwa eyakhe uphendule wathi: “Izindaba ezingamampunge ziholele ebugebengwini. Umasipala uvulele amacala izigebengu ezingu-17, ezidabule ama-CV abantu emahhovisi alo mkhandlu.”Uqhuba athi uyazi ukuthi lo mkhankaso uqhutshwa ngabantu ababehola imashi eyayithi akaphume esikhundleni nyakenye. Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi ungadidiswa ngabantu abanezinhloso zezepolitiki.Umthombo waleli phephandaba uthe umphakathi awuzange ungene kwamasipala, ubume ngaphandle futhi ubungenalo udlame, kodwa kubonakale imeya isifaka izithombe zama-CV kuFacebook, agcwele phansi ethi kwenziwe ngabebevale umasipala.UNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal uthe abakukhuthazi ukuthi kuqashwe ngobungani. “Ukuvala amasango kamasipala ngento esabalele kuFacebook nakho kuyiphutha. SEKUQUBUKE indida ngokuthi babulaweleni abalisa ababili abangabokufika okuthiwa baqale bashawa ngaphambi kokuthi bashiswe babulawe.UMnuz Daniel Dunia wenhlangano elwela amalungelo abantu, i-Africa Solidarity Network (ASONET) uthe basadidekile ngokubulawa kwabalisa ababili baseCongo, uMnuz Alex Msambya (30) noMnuz Nakatanda Mazuruza (32), okuthiwa batholakale beshiswe babulawa emuva kokuthi begcine bebonakala beya e-Adams Mission ngoLwesibili oludlule.UDunia uthe izidumbu zalaba bobabili zitholakale ngoLwesine emakhazeni asePark Rynie emuva kokuthi benyamalale ngoLwesibili. “Bahambe bethi baya e-Adams Mission bayokhanda ifriji kodwa bangabuya. Kuthe uma sibona ukuthi abatholakali sababheka yonke indawo kwaze kwaba sithola ucingo lusibikela ukuthi basemakhazeni. Ngendlela abashe ngayo bekunzima ngisho ukubabona bese sisizwa yizingubo ababezigqokile,” kusho uDunia.Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi akucaci ukuthi babulaweleni oMsambya noMazuruza. Ngokusho kwakhe, sebezame ngayo yonke indlela ukuthola kubantu balapho okuthiwa bashiselwe khona kodwa akekho ofuna ukuphumela obala ngalesi sehlakalo.Kwayizolo uthe bebehambele indawo yesigameko beyozama ukuthola ngokwenzekile kodwa bangamthola umuntu obacaciselayo.“Akekho ofuna ukukhuluma ngokwenzekile kodwa uma sizwa noma sibona indawo okwenzeke kuyona siyabona ukuthi bashawa base beshiswa ngamathayi. Yinto ebuhlungu kakhulu lena kuyabonakala nje ukuthi babulawelwe inzondo yokuthi ababona abakuleli ngoba uma siphenya asisitholi esinye isizathu,” kuchaza uDunia.Ukhale nangokuthi abagculisekile ngophenyo ngokufa kwalaba bobabili njengoba ethe kuze kube manje asikho nesisodwa isitatimende esesitathiwe kubantu balapho okubulawe khona oMsambya noMazuruza.Uthe okunye okumphatha kabuhlungu ukuthi uMsambya bekungaqali ukuthi ahlukumezeke ngenxa yodlame olubhekiswe kwabokufika, ngo-2015 kwenzeka nokwaholela ekutheni agcine engasahlali lapho ayehlala khona kodwa wagcina esehlala ezinkanjini ezazihlala abebalekele ukuhlukunyezwa emphakathini ababehlala kuyo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amabili okubulala emuva kokutholakala kwezidumbu zabesilisa ababili beshisiwe eNkangala, e-Adams Mission. Uthe laba balisa abakaziwa kanti yima kusazokwenziwa ulibofuzo.

AYAVEVA amalungu omndeni wabantu abashona emuva kokuthuthwa esibhedlela sabagula ngengqondo iLife Esidimeni emuva kokuthi iDA ibhale amagama abo oqwembeni lokukhankasela ukhetho ngaphandle kwemvumo yemindeni.Izolo lolu qwembe olungaseBraamfontein, eGoli, olunemibhalo emikhulu ethi, ANC Is Killling Us luhleshuliwe ngabantu okuthiwa ngamalungu omndeni wabafa emuva kokukhishwa eLife Esidimeni.Kulolu qwembe kukhona namagama abavukuzi abafa esibhicongweni saseMarikana nawezingane ezife emuva kokuwela emathoyilethi omgodi.UNkk Christine Nxumalo owashonelwa yilungu lomndeni elakhishwa eLife Esidimeni ubhale ekhasini lakhe le-twitter ukuthi “Ngidinwe kabi ukuthi uMmusi Maimane uvule isikhangiso esinamagama amalungu ethu omndeni ngaphandle kokucela imvume yethu. Imbi lento ayenzile ngoba efuna amavoti. IDA ayinalo ilungelo lokusebenzisa le nhlekelele nobuhlungu bethu ukuze ithole amavoti,”UMnuz Solly Malatsi okhulumela iDA uthe ukuklejulwa koqwembe lwabo kungcolisa umlando walabo abashone ngaphansi kukahulumeni we-ANC.“Yize singaqondi ukuthi wubani oklebhule uqwembe lwethu kodwa akukhona okokuqala simoshelwa uqwembe olukhuluma iqiniso ngohulumeni we-ANC. Lesi senzo singcolisa umlando walabo abashonile ngoba ukufa kwabantu Esidimeni, Marikana nezingane eziphoseka emathoyilethe omgodi bekungavinjwa ukube uhulumeni ka-ANC uyasebenza,” kusho uMalatsi.UMnuz Zizi Kodwa okhulumela i-ANC uthe iDA ayibuqondi ubuhlungu babantu abashonelwa ngamalungu omndeni Esidimeni, eMarikana nakumathoyilethi omgodi futhi uMalatsi neDA kufanele baxolise ebantwini ngalesi senzo.Umhlaziyi wepolitiki uMnuz Ralph Mathekga uthe iDA inawo umlando wokukhankasa ngokugxibha amanye amaqembu epolitiki okuyinto enganambithisiseki kahle kubavoti baseNingizimu Afrika.“IDA ivamise ukukopela izinto ezenziwa e-United States naseBritain zokukhankasa ngokugxibha abanye abaholi. Lo mkhuba uyasebenza kwamanye amazwe hhayi eNingizimu Afrika,” kusho uMathekga.Uthe lesi sikhangiso sikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi iDA ayibaqondi kahle abantu abamnyama ngokosiko, ngokwendlela yokuphila nangokuthi abahlekisi ngokufa.“IDA ayikakabaqondi abantu abamnyama lokhu kuzoyilahlekisela ngabavoti. Kuyakhombisa ukuthi izinto eziningi zisenziwa ngabamhlophe. Kufanele iDA iqaphele ukuthi ukugxibha i-ANC akuyakheli igama elibi kwabamnyama ngoba kufanele ihloniphe namasiko abo ngesikhathi igxeka,” kusho uMathekga.

ILUNGU lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC elijutshwe ukuba libheke ukusebenza kwesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Edna Molewa, liyakuchitha ukuthi uKhongolose esifundazweni unezinkinga ezinzima ezingenza ukuthi ingqungquthela yesifundazwe ingabikhona.Ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba eMeander Manor Hotel, eSalt Rock, izolo ngemuva kwengqungquthela yesifunda iGreater KwaDukuza, uNkk Molewa uthe ubuholi bukazwelonke bufike esifundazweni buzohlola isimo samagatsha nezifunda bathola ukuthi iqembu likulungele ukuthi lingaba nengqungquthela yesifundazwe.“Nakuba zikhona izikhalo kodwa ngezamagatsha ambalwa ezifundeni ezehlukene ezingeke zadala ukuthi kumiswe ingqungquthela yesifundazwe,’’ kusho uNkk Molewa.Uthe akukho okuphambene abakwenzile kodwa balandele yonke imigomo ekumthethosisekelo weqembu mayelana nezingqungquthela.“Umgomo weqembu uthi ukuze kube nengqungquthela kumele * -70% wamagatsha ube sesimeni esihle. Cishe zonke izifunda zingaphezu kwalesi sibalo esifunekayo.”Uthe ingqungquthela yesifundazwe izoba khona ngaphambi kokuphela kukaMeyi.“Bekulindeleke ukuthi ingqungquthela ibe ngempelasonto kaMeyi 18-20 kodwa lokho kubukeka kungeke kusenzeka ngoba kukhona izifunda ezizobe zihlangene. Akukwazi ukuthi kungaba nengqungquthela yezifunda kube kuneyesifundazwe.”Uthe noma ngabe kuthiwa kukhona izifunda ezinenkinga lokhu ngeke kuyiphazamise ingqungquthela yesifundazwe.“Izithunywa kaziyi engqungqutheleni yesifundazwe ngoba zithunywe yizifunda zazo kodwa ziya ngoba zithunywe ngamagatsha azo.”Uncome ingqungquthela yaseGreater KwaDukuza wathi ibe yimpumelelo enkulu wanxusa zonke izifunda ezisazokhetha ukuthi zisike iphethini kwaDukuza.Ubongele nobuholi obusha besifunda iGreater KwaDukuza wathi uyathemba ukuthi buzokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngendlela.Ingqungquthela yaKwaDukuza ikhethe ubuholi obusha ngo-elethu engqungqutheleni ethathe izinsuku ezimbili.UMnuz Ricardo Mthembu obevele enguSihlalo wesifunda uphinde wabuyela esikhundleni sakhe okwesithathu. Uke waba nguSihlalo we-ANCYL esifundeni.UMthembu uthe ujabule ngokuthi amaqabane aphinde amthembe ngokuthi usengakwazi ukuwahola.Uthe uzosebenza kanzima ukuzama ukuqeda ukwehlukana okukhona kumalungu.“Ukwehlukana okukhona enhlanganweni kubhebhethekiswa wubuholi, yithina futhi esisukayo siyoxova amagatsha,” kusho uMthembu.Uthe uzimisele ngokusebenzisana nesigungu sakhe ukuyisa uKhongolose phambili.Ingqungquthela yaKwaDukuza ngeyokuqala KwaZulu-Natal ngemuva kokuthi ubuholi bukazwelonke bathatha isinqumo sokuthi zime kancane.Ngempelasonto ezayo kulindeleke ukuthi kube neyezifunda ezine kanye kanye okukhona kuzo iMusa Dladla, Far North, Emalahleni neNkosi Bhambatha.Ngempelasonto ezolandela kulindeleke ukuba kube neyeMoses Mabhida, Abaqulusi, Harry Gwala neLower South Coast.Ukuphumelela kukaMthembu esifundeni iGreater KwaDukuza kusho ukuthi uhlangothi lukaMnuz Sihle Zikalala lusahamba phambili ngo 1-0, njengoba kulungiselelwa ingqungquthela yesifundazwe.Kodwa akwaziwa ukuthi izozala nkomini kulezi ezinye izifunda eziyisishiyagalombili okusamele zihlangane.

text: UYISE wowesilisa osolwa ngokubulala umfundi waseMangosuthu University of Technology, osedume ngokuqhuba intwala ngewisa, uthi kunzima ukukholwa yizinsolo ezibekwe kuMnuz Thabani Mzolo (23).UMnuz Mthembeni Majola oyikhansela le-IFP onguyise kaMzolo ongamzali uthi ubechitha isikhathi esiningi naye njengendodana yakhe. Uthi njengoyise kunzima ukukholwa yonke into eshiwoyo ngaye.“Sizokholwa uma sekuphuma ubufakazi benkantolo obuzoveza ukuthi esikabani isibhamu,” usho kanje.Phambilini kuke kwavela ukuthi uMajola ubegadwa wuMzolo, kodwa uthi lokhu akulona iqiniso. Uthi bebehlale bendawonye ngoba uMzolo eyindodana yakhe yize engamzali.Uthi njengomndeni bamazi njengengane ezithobile futhi ehlale ilubalubela ukufukula abanye.UMzolo usedume ngokuqhuba intwala ngewisa njengoba kuleli sonto kuvele ukuthi ukhombise iMantshi umunwe ophakathi nendawo.Nakubantu abasuke beyothamela icala, usedume ngokuthi avele abakhombe ngophawu lwesibhamu esebenzisa iminwe yakhe.UMajola uthi kwenzeka lokhu nje uMzolo ubesemfundisa inkonzo emvakashisa emathempelini ahlukene ebandla lakaShembe.“Thina njengomndeni wakhe sizokholwa ngesikuzwa ngenkantolo, nakhona kube nobufakazi obuphathekayo.Okunye okushiwo abantu emaceleni ngeke sikulalele kakhulu,” kusho uMajola.Uthe uMzolo ubewusizo ezinganeni eziningi ezifundisa izibalo, sekukhona nezineziqu ngenxa yakhe.Mayelana nokuthi uMzolo ubewunogada, uMajola uthe: “Ubengeke abe ngumfundi aphinde abe ngunogada, ubehlala ehamba nami ngoba sihlobene."Ukuba unogada kuhambisana nezinto eziningi namalayisensi enziwayo. Akakaze angigade futhi angazi kuqhamuke nobani lokho,” kusho uMajola.UMajola uthe uyazi ukuthi umndeni wakaKhumalo uphatheke kabuhlungu ngokwenzekile, nabo bayazwelana nawo kodwa abafuni ukuhlangana nawo kusenje.“Uma abantu bebhekene nesimo esifana nalesi akumele nibajahe eduze. Sifisa baphole kuqala bese sikwazi ukubavakashela. Nathi sisadidekile kodwa uma enganikezwa abameli abawaziyo umthetho, kuningi okungavela ngaleli cala,” kusho uMajola.Ephetha uthe uma ligcina ngokumlahla icala futhi naye ekuvuma konke okuvezwa yinkantolo bazokwamukela njengomndeni ukuthi kunohlangothi lwakhe abebengalwazi.NgoLwesine iNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini isichithile isicelo sebheyili sikaMzolo kulandela ukuvela kwenkinga yekheli lakhe eliqondile njengoba nezinye zezihlobo zakhe zimuhlangulile.

IPHINI lomqeqeshi we-Orlando Pirates, uRulani Mokwena, liqininisekisa eyezinguquko ezinqala ezizokwenzeka eqenjini ngaphambi kokuqala kwesizini ka-2018/2019.IPirates iqede isizini ka-2017/2018 isendaweni yesibili kwi-log ye-Absa Premiership. Icindeze ompetha iMamelodi Sundowns kwaze kwaba sekugcineni. Ithimba labaqeqeshi bePirates belizivalele esifubeni izifiso zalo ngoba belilokhu lithi lisazama ukwakha iqembu.Umqeqeshi, uMilutin “Micho”Sredojevic, uphumele obala sekuzophela isizini ngokuthi iqembu lesifinyelele ezingeni lokunqoba izindebe ngoba sebesakhile isisekelo esiqinile. EZimnyama zizohambisana neSundowns emqhudelwaneni iCAF Champions League ngesizini ezayo.UMokwena uthe zinkulu izinguquko ezizokwenzeka ngaphambi kokuthatha inya­thuko yeCAF. Kunenqwaba yabadlali asebevele bakhonjwa kwiPirates okukhona kubo uLinda Mntambo, no-Abel Mabaso abebekwiChippa United. UMeshack Maphangule weBlack Leopards kuthiwa usevumelene nePirates. Kubadlali okuthiwa bayashiya kukhona uThamsanqa Gabuza, Ayanda Gcaba, Thamsanqa Sangweni nabanye.“Isikwati sizoqina kakhulu. Sizoligcina iningi labadlali kodwa sizoqina kakhulu ngesizini ezayo. IChampions League iyeza ngakho kufanele sengeze abadlali, sithole nabanye abasezingeni eliphezulu. Sidinga ukwengeza okungenani zonke izindawo. Nasethimbeni labaqeqeshi kuzoba khona izinguquko,” kusho uMokwena.Maphakathi nesizini kusabalale amahlebezi okuthi uSimo Dladla, umqeqeshi weKings yaKwaZulu-Natal edlala kwiNational First Division (NFD), uzojoyina ithimba labaqeqeshi kwiPirates. Kumanje iphini lesibili likaMicho nguBenson Mhlongo owayengumdlali wePirates.Abadlali bePirates abebekade beqokelwe imiklomelo yePremie Soccer League (PSL) babuye belambatha. U-Innocent Maela ukhale ngaphansi kuSiyanda Xulu kowe-Absa Premiership Defender of The Season, kwathi uMusa Nyatama wahlulwa nguSiphesihle Ndlovu weMaritzburg United kowe-Absa Premiership Midfielder of The Season.UMicho ubengakufihlanga ukuthi uNyatama uyena okufanele akhale emuke nomklomelo womdlali ovelele, i-PSL Footballer of The Season, ogcine ugoduke noPercy Tau weSundowns.“Okubalulekile wukuqokwa kule miklomelo. Kodwa-ke abantu okubafanele ukuwina bawinile. Lokhu kuzosigqugquzela ukuthi sisebenze kanzima,” kuphetha uMokwena.

text: KUSHAQEKE umndeni isoka leminyaka licuthela intombi ngovivi, iya esikoleni layigwaza liphindelela yashona khona lapho kulandela ingxabano, okusolwa ukuthi ibihlangene nokuthi isoka belingafuni umufi abuyele esikoleni.UNosiphiwo Ntombela (18) obefunda uGrade 11 eKlwana Combined School, eBabanango, kuvela ukuthi ubehleli ekhaya iminyaka emithathu ekhulisa ingane yabo, kulo nyaka wakhetha ukubuyela esikoleni ngoba eseyibona isikhulile.Kuzwakala ukuthi lezi zindaba azehlanga kahle esokeni njengoba liwumuntu obegajwa isikhwele ngobala futhi lihlala linolaka, obekwenza umufi ahlale engathokozile.Udadewabo omdala kamufi uthi leli soka belivele lihlala limchukuluza udadewabo kodwa ubengazitsheli ukuthi lingaze limbulale. UNksz Ntombela uthe naye belike limfonele limtshela ngezinsolo elinazo ngodadewabo.Uthe belihlale lisho izinto ezihambisana nokumsola ukuthi uyajola kodwa lingabuvezi ubufakazi balokho.Ngokusho kwesinye isihlobo salo mndeni esingathandanga ukudalulwa, leli soka bese libamba amatoho eGoli. Kuthe uma lizwa ukuthi unina wengane yalo usebuyele esikoleni, kwangalithokozisa lokho, lafuthelana njengoba lize lamcuthela eya esikoleni. Kuthiwa belijwayele ukumsola ngomjolo kodwa libuye lixolise.“Kubuhlungu lokhu asizwise khona ngoba kucacile wehlulwe ukwamukela ukuthi ubudlelwano babo bese buphelile. Akekho obemazi ukuthi ukhona ngoba sizwe sekufona omakhelwane ekuseni kade esanda kuhamba udadewethu.“Uphume la ekhaya ngo-6. 20 ngoba isikole sithanda ukuqhela. Kusho ukuthi ubemcuthele endleleni. Ngimfice enamanxeba amaningi okugwazwa.“Abemaningi ngendlela yokuthi ngihlulekile ngisho ukubona ukuthi abemangaki,” kusho uNksz Ntombela ovele wakhihla isililo ngenxa yomunyu.NoMnyango wezeMfundo izolo uzwakalise okukhulu ukushaqeka ngalesi sigameko.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa uthe ihhovisi likaNgqongqoshe lizwelana kakhulu nomndeni nothisha nabafundi ngalesi sigameko.“Sidumele ngokwehlele lo mfundi. Sidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini nesikole sakhe. Siyethemba umthetho uzokwenza okufanele. Sidinga ukubambisana nomphakathi ukulwa nodlame,” kusho uMlotshwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uCaptain Nqobile Gwala usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko nokuthi umufi ugwazwe umuntu owaziwayo esendleleni. UKUSHISA ithayi noma ukuchela igceke ngoshiboshi akuzibalekisi izinyoka emzini wakho.Lokhu kushiwo uMnuz Jason Arnold owungoti obamba izinyoka eThekwini. Uthe izinyoka eziningi aseke wazibamba emizini yabantu zisuke zikulo lelo gceke okusuke kukade kushiswa kulo ithayi noma elichelwe ngoshibhoshi  ngenhloso yokuthi iphume lapho icashe khona.Uthe inyoka iphuma lapho icashe khona kuphela ima ibona sengathi isivalelekile noma izibona sengathi isengozini.“Angazi ukuthi ubani owaqhamuka nesu lokushisa ithayi nokuchela ngamanzi anoshibhoshi egcekeni. Abanye batshala ishaladi noma u-anyanisi eduze kwezindlu ngoba bekholwa ukuthi kuzoqhelisa izinyoka, iqiniso ukuthi lezi zinto azizivimbi izinyoka ukuthi zihambe egcekeni. Uma inyoka izibona ukuthi ivikelekile iyazihlalela noma ngabe lezi zinto zenziwe kulelo gceke,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi izinyoka zibonakala kakhulu phakathi kulaSepthemba noNovemba ngoba yisikhathi lapho zisuke zimatasa khona zakha imindeni emisha, ngakho ziphuma lapho zisuke zicashe khona ukuze zithole ophathina.Uthe ezinye sezizathu ukuthi entswasahlobo kuba nezimvula  bese kuba nezinambuzane namaxoxo adliwa yizo izinyoka, ziyaphuma ziyozingela.Uthe yize indawo ngayinye kungenzeka ibe nezinyoka ezingu-25 ezehlukene kodwa zikhona izinyoka ezivamise ukubonakala  ezindaweni eziningi kuleli, njengemamba emnyama, night adder, vino snakes, Boomslang, istilletto neMozambique spitting cobra.Uthe nakuba zonke izinyoka zinobuthi  kodwa zikhona ezinobuthi obungabulali kodwa obuholela ekutheni uvuvukale noma ulahlekelwe yilelo lunga lomzimba elilunywe yinyoka njenge-stiletto.Uqhube wathi izinyoka ziluma abantu ngoba zisuke zicabanga ukuthi zisengozini noma ziyahlaselwa kodwa azibahlaseli abantu, uma inyoka ikubone kuqala uthe iyabaleka. Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka ususe zonke izinto ezigaba yikhaya lezinyoka njengezinkuni, uthayela nezinye izinto ezingaba segcekeni. Uthe uma lezi zinto zikhona egcekeni kumele zinganciki enhlabathini ngoba izinyoka yiyathanda ukuhlala endaweni emnyama, azifuni ukuhlala endaweni lapho zizophazanyiswa khona izinja nezinye izilwane.  Izihlahla ezinde kanye notshani obude uthe nakho akudingeki ngalesi sikhathi.Uthe uma kwenzeka ulunywa yinyoka kumele ubophe inxeba ngebhandishi, bese uphuthuma esikhungweni sezempilo. Uthe kumele uqaphele ukuthi awuliqinisi kakhulu kuze kuphazamiseke ukuhamba kwegazi ngoba ungagcina uqunywa kanti inyoka ekulumile ayinabo ubuthi.Uqhube wathi kumele wehlise ukwethuka ngoba ukushaya ngamandla kwenhliziyo ngenxa yokwethuka kungaholela ekutheni ubuthi busheshe busabalale emzimbeni.Uthe ukukwazi ukuchaza ukuthi inyoka ekulumile ibinjani kuyabasiza abasesikhungweni sezempilo kodwa abasebenzi bezempilo  bayakwazi ukubona ngezimpawu zesiguli, ukuthi silunywe yiyiphi inyoka.Uma kuyingane engakhulumi elunywe yinyoka uthe kunzima ukuba nesiqiniseko sokuthi ilunywe yinyoka kodwa ezinye zezimpawu ongazibona ukuthi ingane iphalaze,noma ihluleke ukuphefumula kahle.

text: I-IFP ithi ukhetho lwangoMeyi 8 luzocacisa ukuthi ngubani umakhonya phakathi kweNkatha ne-ANC. Lokhu kuvele ngoLwesihlanu ngesikhathi kunomhlangano oyisipesheli wesiShayamthetho mayelana nokuba sihlakazwe kuleli hlandla eliphelayo leminyaka emihlanu ukuze amaqembu akwazi ukukhankasela ukhetho luka-2019.UMnuz Nhlanhla Msimango we-IFP utshele amalungu kaKhongolose ukuthi umbuso wabo ubaliwe njengoba kuza ukhetho.“Ngithi kini Mene, mene, tekel, upharsin. Ngithi uMbuso wenu Macingwane nawe Zikalala uphelile. Sizobuyisa okwethu. Ngemuva kokhetho siyiNkatha sizobe sihleli kulolo hlangothi siphethe isifundazwe, nina ningapha emabhentshini aphikisayo. Kulo nyaka kuzocaca ukuthi obani amadoda ebafaneni. Uqhude manikiniki kuyaphela ngani ngoba nehlulekile,” kusho uMsimango obehhewulwa i-ANC.UMnuz Sihle Zikalala we-ANC uthe kufana nokudlala okushiwo uMsimango ngoba i-ANC ibasebenzele abantu baKwaZulu-Natal ngakho abaziboni bebuyela emuva.“Sithathe lo hulumeni izinga lokuphasa kuka-matric liphansi kakhulu kodwa namhlanje sithola imiphumela engamaphesenti angu-76. Namhlanje abantu bakithi banemigwaqo nengqalasizinda ngenxa kaloKhongolose. Mhlonishwa uMsimango sithi siyohlangana okhethweni,” kusho uZikalala.Ubonge wonke amalungu esiShayamthetho ngokusebenzisana kahle.USotswebhu we-ANC, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, uthe nakuba isiShayamthetho sihlakaziwe ngokwezigaba ezithile zomthetho kodwa imisebenzi izoqhubeka.“ISilo samabandla wonke sizoqhubeka sizovula isiShayamthetho ngoLwesibili bese kulandela uNdunankulu nenkulumo ezobe ichaza kabanzi ngesimo sesifundazwe. Ngisho amakomiti azoqhubeka nemisebenzi yomphakathi ,” kusho uNksz Boyce.

IZAZI zomnotho zidonse ngendlebe abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya ngoba kuzoshuba njengoba sekuzozwakala ukunyuka kwentengo ekhokhwa uma uthenga impahla, iValue Added Tax (VAT) enyuke ngo-1% isuka ku-14% yaya ku-15%.UMnuz Jason Urbach oyisazi somnotho kwiFree Market Foundation, uthe ukunyuka kweVAT kuzoshubisa ngoba kuzozwela kuwo wonke umuntu.“Abantu kufanele babophe izifociya ngoba intela izobaphilisa kabuhlungu. Abampofu bazoyikhokha iVAT ngoba akudliwa impuphu kuphela kodwa bayayidla inyama nokunye okuningi. Bazokhokha kakhulu noma begibela ngoba ukunyuka kwentela kaphethroli kusho ukuthi osomatekisi bazonyusa imali yokugibela, ukuze benze inzuzo,” kusho u-Urbach.UNobhala weCosatu KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Edwin Mkhize, uthe namhlanje bazoqhinqa ngaphandle kwamahhovisi oMnyango wezeziMali eMgungundlovu, emgwaqweni uChief Albert Luthuli ngoba bafuna yehliswe iVAT.“Silindele ukuthi uhulumeni wethu njengoba ehlale ethi uyabalalela abantu, asilalele ayehlise iVAT ngoba ihlukumeza wonke umuntu. Yebo kukhona ukudla okuthiwa uma ukuthenga ngeke uyikhokhe iVAT kodwa lokhu akuwususi umthwalo emahlombe abantu. Sifuna uhulumeni ayehlise iVAT,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe banethemba lokuthi uhulumeni uzoyehlisa iVAT ngoba umkhankaso wabo wokuthi yehle uyaqhubeka.UMengameli weCosatu, uMnuz Sdumo Dlamini uthe baxoxe nobuholi be-ANC ngodaba lweVAT kodwa bebengakaxoxi noMnyango wezeziMali.Uthe sebeqalile ukumasha ngoba bafuna ukuthumela umyalezo ocacile wokuthi abahambisani nokunyuka kweVAT.Khona manjalo inkampani ekhiqiza ukudla iWillowton Group, iveze ukuthi ngeke iyinyuse iVAT ngo-Ephreli, Meyi nangoJuni ukuze ivikele abathengi.Isikhulu esiphezulu seWillowton Group, uMnuz Zubeir Moosa sithe bayazi ukuthi iVAT izoshubisela abathengi yingakho bekhethe ukungayinyusi kuyo yonke imikhiqizo yabo okungenani izinyanga ezintathu.“Sicela nezinye izinkampani zingayinyusi iVAT izinyanga ezimbalwa, ukuze abathengi bangathwali kanzima,” kunxusa uMoosa.
Le nkampani yasungulwa ngowezi-2014 abangani abahla-nu abangongoti ezimbonini zamakhemikhali, izimpahla ezithengisa ngokushesha, ukwe nziwa kwemikhiqizo, kanye nokunamathelisayo.

PHEZU kokuba izinyunyana zothisha ziyamukela inkulumo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngendaba yokuthuthukisa imfundo ngokuthi kube nama-tablet kubona bonke abafundi kuleli kodwa ezinye izinto zithi zingagcina zingenzekanga.URamaphosa umemezele izinto eziningi uhulumeni ahlose ukuzenza kwezemfundo njengokuthi uhlelo lwama-tablet luqale ezikoleni ezisemakhaya nasemalokishini, kuguqulwe izikole eziningi zibe ngezamakhono kanjalo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kunezindlu zangasese kuzona zonke izikole.UMengameli weNatu, uMnuz Allen Thompson, uthe noma bekwamukela konke okushiwo nguMengameli ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo ebibhekiswe esizweni ngeledlule kodwa okunye kwakho ngeke kwenzeke.Uthe kumele kuqeqeshwe othisha ngezobuchwepheshe njengoba kuzomele bafundise abafundi abaphethe ama-tablet.Uqhube wathi kunezikole ezingenawo ugesi namanzi, izindlu zangasese, unogada futhi kazibiyiwe.“Uma uletha ubuchwepheshe obunje udinga zonke lezi zinto. Izikole azinikiwe nemali ngumnyango, ezinye azinazo nezincwadi zokufunda. Angiyiphathi eyonogada abakhokhelwa ngumnyango yiphupho ezikoleni eziningi okusho ukuthi uma sebufakiwe lobu buchwepheshe buzokwebiwa. Ezinye zezikole azinazo izindlu ama-strongroom okugcina impahla ebalulekile, kwezinye izicabha nama-buglar guards akukho,” kusho uThompson.Uthe kungathatha isikhathi ukuthi lezi zinto zilungiswe kuzona zonke izikole.“Sifuna ungqongqoshe wezemfundo kuzwelomke abuyise uhlelo lokuthi othisha bathole ama-laptop. Lolu hlelo kwaxoxwa ngalo lwaze lwaya nasePhalamende lwagcina lungafinyelelanga ndawo.”Uthe izinto eziningi uMengameli abekhuluma ngazo zizogcina ezikoleni ezazingama-Model C ezinezinsiza.Okhulumela iSadtu, uNksz Nomusa Cembi, uthe bafuna othisha baqeqeshwe ngezinto ezithinta ubuchwepheshe.Uthe bayakwamukela okushiwo nguRamaphsoa wathi kumele kusheshiswe indaba yezindlu zangasese.“Indaba yezindlu zangasese yinto okumele isheshiswe ngoba kunabafundi abafayo ngoba bephonseka kwingqalasizinda engekho esimeni. Abaqeqeshwe othisha ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezinto ezithinta ubuchwepheshe.”Uthe badumele ukuthi akukho okushiwo ngendaba yekhomishini eyajutshwa ngowayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma eyayizobhekana namaholo abasebenzi bakahulumeni iqale ngawothisha.“Akushiwo lutho ngale khomishini okunalokho kukhulunywa indaba yokuthi kuzodilizwa. Siyajabulangenkulumo kaMengameli kodwa ezinye zezinto kusekude ukuthi zenzeke.”URamaphosa umemezele nokuthi kuzoqalwa nezifundo zamakhono nezintsha okubalwa iTechnical Mathematics neTechnical Sciences, Maritime Sciences, Aviation Studies, Mining Sciences neQuaponics.

I-ANC nayo yabhala icela ukunikwa ithuba lokuziphendulela ezintweni ezishiwo kule khomishini. Sizolinda uSihlalo ukuthi asitshele uma ithuba selivelile. Asikwazi ukuphawula kakhulu ngezethulo zofakazi abangahlonywanga imibuzo ngabanye abantu kodwa sigqugquzela abantu ukuthi bazokwethula ubufakazi ukuze kuliwe nokusetshenziswa kombuso yidlanzana elifuna ukufeza izinhloso zalo,” kusho uKodwa.Izolo u-Adv Phillip Mokoena ohola ubufakazi utshele ikhomishini ukuthi uthole izitatimende ezimbili ezivela kuSihlalo we-ANC uMnuz Gwede Mantashe obephendula izinto zayizolo.UNksz Hogan usole owayenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngokugxambukela ezindabeni zombuso njengoba wayefuna kuqokwe izikhulu ezithandwa wuyena ezinkampanini zikahulumeni.Uveze ukuthi uZuma wazama ukuvikela owayeyisikhulu sakwa-Eskom uMnuz Jacob Maroga owasula esikhundleni kodwa wafuna ukubuyiselwa kuso.“UMaroga watshela ibhodi ukuthi uyasula esikhundleni waze waphuma emhlanganweni ayekuwo. Waphinde wasihoxisa isinqumo sakhe kwase kungenelela uZuma owathi asimbuyisele esikhundleni. Njengoba uZuma wayengekho eNingizimu Afrika ngaleso sikhathi ngabuza kowayeyiPhini likaMengameli uMnuz Kgalema Motlanthe ukuthi ngenzenjani. Wangitshela ukuthi angenze okufanele ngikwenze ngoba ngeke agxambukele,” kusho uNksz Hogan.Uthe emuva kwalokho wathola ucingo kuZuma owathukuthele emtshela ukuthi akayeke lento ayenzekayo.Uveze ukuthi uZuma wamtshela ukuthi uMaroga usaseyisikhulu esiphezulu kwa-Eskom yize ibhodi lalinganeme ngomsebenzi wakhe.“Saba nenkulumo mpikiswano noMengameli ngoba nganginganeme neze ngoMaroga owayezenzela intando yakhe. Ngabona kahle ukuthi uMaroga ubexoxa noMengameli (Zuma) ngasese,” kusho uNksz Hogan.Uthe emuva kokucaca kokuthi akafuni ukulandela okushiwo wuZuma watshelwa ukuthi uMengameli uzomjuba eFinland ayoba yinxusa khona kodwa wanqaba ngenxa yokuthi umyeni wakhe oyisishoshovu somzabalazo, uMnuz Ahmed Kathrada, wayesethuthela eGoli.

Umbukiso usuvulele osomabhizinisi abaningi emkhakheni wemfashini ithuba lokukhula kulo mkhakha.Ukumenywa kukaNtuli kuqhamuke emuva kokuba abohlaka lwezohwebo nokutshalwa kwezimali esifundazweni bebone umsebenzi wakhe. Umsebenzi wakhe bawubona kwezinye zezimakethe ezikhangisa ngomsebenzi esifundazweni.“Ngijabule kakhulu ukuthola ithuba ngoba bekuvele kuyiphupho lami ukuthi umsebenzi wami ufinyelele nakwamanye amazwe. Bekuqala ukuthi lo mcimbi ubanjelwe kuleli selokhu wasungulwa njengoba ububanjelwe eKapa.UNkk Sibisi ohola nohlelo lwezilimi kwiSchool of Arts, khona e-UKZN, uthe ukuhlabana kwakhe ngale ndondo kusho ukuthi uyabonakala umkhankaso wokuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu.“Umkhankaso wokuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu akuyona into yakuleli kuphela kodwa eyawo wonke amazwe. Ngisho abe-Unesco bayakukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwalezi zilimi. Ukuthola kwami le ndondo kusho ukuthi nowethu umkhankaso uyabonakala. Izilimi zethu zanyathelwa kakhulu ngenxa yomlando wobandlululo, okuyimanje sizama ukulungisa lowo monakalo,” kusho yena.Uthe zonke izifundo ngisho ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kumele zifundwe ngezilimi zesintu. Uveze ukuthi e-UKZN sebeqalile ukusebenzisa amanye amatemu ezilimi zesintu abaqhamuke nawo.“Awukho umkhakha noma izifundo ezingeke zingafundeki ngezilimi zesintu. Uma sebefuna ukusigxeka laba abangafuni siqhakambise izilimi zethu, basishaya ngokuthi kunamatemu angeke asebenziseke kahle esiZulwini. Okuhle ukuthi ezinye izilimi ziyahambelana, kungabolekwa amagama ukwakha amanye amatemu. Awekho amagama angeke atholakele uma sizimisele, ngisho emkhakheni wezomthetho nowezesayensi,” echaza.UNkk Sibisi osefundise iminyaka emine e-UKZN, kumanje wenza iPhD lapho enza khona ucwaningo ngezilimi zesintu. Ucwaninga ukuthi amatemu esiZulu aseqalile ukusetshenziswa kulesi sikhungo ayazisiza yini izitshudeni ukuthi ziqonde kangcono ezifundiswa kona ngolimi lwazo.Ukuhlabana kwakhe ngendondo kunezelwe nayindlela alwethule kahle ngayo ucwaningo obeluhambisana nokukhuthaza izitshudeni zale nyuvesi ukuthi zihaye izinkondlo zisebenzisa amatemu emikhakha yemfundo ezikuyo.UNkk Sibisi ubonge umphathi wakhe uSolwazi Heike Tappe, athe nguye omkhuthazayo emsebenzini wakhe kulesi sikhungo. I-international Congress of Linguist yasungulwa ngo-1928 kanti izingcithabuchopho zezilimi zamazwe ahlukene ziyahlangana njalo eminyakeni eyisihlanu ukubhunga ngezokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi.

text: MHLELI: Ngicela ukuthi ungidlulisele ukuphatheka kabi kwami ngesenzo esenzeka lapha ebandleni selokhu kwahlala ubaba uNyazi ebandleni. Okokuqala, ngizobeka kucace ukuthi ngokwenqubo yaleli bandla uma kuzongena imihlangano eyaye yenziwe kathathu onyakeni, okuyinhlangano kaJanuwari, Julayi no-Okthoba kumele kuthethelelwe bonke abebemisiwe ngenxa yokuphambana nomthetho webandla noma ngamacala athile abasuke bewenzile, bephula imithetho kaNkulunkulu. Kodwa lokhu sibona sekushaywa indiva nobaba sengathi uyehluleka ukuphuma nento ecacile njengomholi webandla. Abantu bayazenzela nje, akanendaba futhi uyehluleka ukumela iqiniso njengoba kunguye owokugcina okumele aphume nezwi eliwujuqu.Ngikhuluma nje kunabagcotshwa abayilokhu bamiswa. Manje sekungaphezulu kweminyaka eyisithupha udaba lwabo lungakhulumeki, yena ubaba uthulile nje akabashayi mkhuba noma sebekhalela ukuthi phela abaxolelwe, babuyele esontweni. Ngokwenqubo yebandla lokhu akwenzeki.Siyamangala-ke ngoba lokhu kuyaphambana nomthetho kanti nekomiti elimiselwe ukulungisa izindaba zebandla lizithulele nje. Manje angisazi ukuthi leli bandla libhekephi uma kunjalo. Uma yena engabathetheleli njengomnikazi wesonto kanti ngubani okumele abathethelele? Futhi uma yena engabazweli ngubani kanti ozobazwela ngoba uma bexabene, engabalamuli ngabe ulindele ukuthi kuze kuchitheke igazi yini lapha ebandleni? Yonke le mihlangano engiyibalile iyangena nje bamisiwe laba bantu, abasonti ndawo, abasazazi noma basengamaNazaretha noma sebeyini. Uma belahlwa benganakwa kanti yini lena engaka abayona lapha ebandleni edala bangiyitholi intethelelo?Uma bengahamba manje emhlabeni bengathethelelwe kuyothiwani? Sengisola ukuthi naye ubaba akalinakile ibandla ukuthi abantu bayezwana noma cha. Laba bagcotshwa ngingabala oMfundisi Khanyi, Mavuso, Ngema, Mchunu noMvangeli uMtshali. Angisazi kahle noma bamisiwe noma baxoshiwe yini ebandleni. Ngikhuluma nje lona omunye uMfundisi Richard Mchunu wake wazidela weza mathupha ethi uzozicelela intethelelo kuye ubaba uNyazi kepha wavinjwa ngamanye amalungu ebandla, amfaka induku phambi kwakhe ubaba. Ngelanga ashaywa ngalo kwakuyiSabatha kwakukhona ngisho iSilo Samabandla sivakashile, okungavumelekile-ke emthethweni kaNkulunkulu ukuba kwenzeke. Futhi lokhu kwakumele ubaba njengomholi aphume nezwi eliwujuqu ngaso leso sikhathi, ayilungise yena le ndaba yalaba bagcotshwa abathethelele babuyele esontweni nabo bazikhonzele. Kepha yena wathi laba bantu abaxabene bebodwa, abasale bayilungise le ndaba yokuxabana kwabo wasuka washiya kulenga kunjalo.Le nto eyenzekayo lapha ebandleni isiphethe kabi kakhulu ngoba ihlambalaza ibandla likaNkulunkulu wasekuPhakameni. Angikaze ngiyibone le nto ngoba kuyimanje kukhona abanye abagcotshwa abamisiwe futhi nabo okungezwakali kahle ukuthi benze sono sini.UThingolwenkosazana lwalungahambisani nokushaywa nokuxoshwa kwabantu esontweni noma ngabe benzeni. Lwaluze lusho luthi mina angixoshi muntu ngoba nobaba abazange baxoshe muntu. Kodwa manje lokhu sekuyinsakavukela nje ebandleni. Siyibandla siyamangala ukuthi sekuyisonto elinjani kanti leli uma selinjena. Ngiyafisa ukuthi nesigungu esiphezulu silusukumele ngokukhulu ukushesha lolu daba lwalaba bagcotshwa, babuyiselwe ebandleni nabo bakhonze.Le nto ibuhlungu ngoba laba bantu banezingane namakhosikazi abangazi lutho futhi angone lutho. Nabo bayathinteka abasasonti ndawo ngoba kumiswe oyise nabayeni babo. Ngicela isonto lingaphenduki kube yikwamachanca kwampunzi edla emini lingaphenduki libe yihlathi ekubeni kunomholi nesigungu esimiselwe ukulungisa lezi zindaba. Njengoba nje kuzoba nomhlangano lapha eGoli kuyo lenyanga bengicela babuyiswe laba bagcotshwa, kungadlalwa ngokukholwa kwabo ngoba bengenamkhulumeli.Ngifisa ukuthi kuphele lokhu kuxabana okukhona ngaphansi kobuholi boNyazi nalo alusukume lubonise ubuholi balo luqede le ngxabano ekhona esithathe iminyaka eminingi kangaka.Uma lwehluleka ukulamula le ngxabano ngifisa bamiswe nalaba abanye abagcotshwa abaxabene nalaba abemisiwe baze babuyele esontweni sebebuyisene ngoba basonta kanjani bona bexabene nabanye?Sekwaze kwaba khona omunye umuzi owakheka phezu kwenzondo khona lapha eGoli, okuyaye kuthi uma uNyazi luze kulona omunye umuzi abanye abavumelekile ukungena kuwo ngoba kuxatshenwe. Uma selulethe umhlangano kulona omunye futhi laba abanye abavumelekile ukungena kuwo.Ubaba uyawubuka nje lo msindo uyaqhubeka. Bengilokhu ngithi uzowunaka awulungise njengenhloko. Manje zidla amahlanga phambi kwakhe abantu bayazenzela nje. Iyakhathaza le nto ngoba isisontisa kabi uma sinyonkolozana kabi kangaka ngoba awukwazi ukukhuluma nalaba abanye ngoba uthathwa njengevukela mbuso kulaba abamise, abanye kushiwo lokhu nalokhu. “Wonke amaNazaretha mawabe munye njengebumba likasimende.” Ameni, ngiyabonga.OkhathazekileEGAUTENG

text: UKUBE alifikanga iloli elicisha umlilo livela esikhumulweni iPrince Mangosuthu Buthelezi Airport, ngabe ishe yangqongqa inxanxathela yezitolo Ulundi Plaza ngoba uMasipala wasoLundi awunalo iloli lokucisha umlilo omkhulu.Lokhu kudalulwe yiMenenja kaMasipala wasoLundi, uMntwana uNkosenye Zulu, engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe emuva kokusha kwezitolo ezinhlanu, ikhemisi nezindawo zokusebenzela odokotela ezintathu, oLundi Plaza, ngoLwesibili ntambama.UZulu uthe umlilo uqale esitolo sefenisha i-OK Furniture wase uthungeleka ekhemisi, wadlulela ezitolo zezimpahla nasendaweni kadokotela wamehlo, eyowamazinyo neyowezifo zonke (GP).“Imenenja yakwa-OK ithe umonakalo ubalelwa ngaphezu kuka-R2 million. Abanye abanikazi bezitolo bebesaqoqa impahla engashanga ngoba umlilo uqale kwa-OK kwase kuhanguleka ezinye izitolo. Sibuhlungu ngale nhlekelele evelile futhi sicela umhlonishwa uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube asilekelele sithole iloli lokucisha umlilo,” kusho uZulu.Uthe uma kunomlilo baye basebenzise iveni enethangi lamanzi ukuwucisha kodwa le veni ihlulekile wukucisha owayizolo.“Uma umlilo umkhulu siye sicele usizo kuMasipala waseZululand oneloli lokucisha umlilo elilodwa ukuzisa bonke omasipala abancane. NgoLwesibili, belisayoseviswa ngakho siye saxakeka. Kusize ukungenelela kweMeya yaseZululand, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, osicelele iloli lasePrince Mangosuthu Buthelezi Airport ukuba lizosicishela. Ukube alifikanga ngabe kushe yonke into,” kusho uZulu.Uthe abakwazi ukuzithengela iloli labo lokucisha umlilo ngenxa yokuthi bathola imali encane kwisabelomali sikazwelonke futhi ababaningi abantu abakhokha ama-rates njengoba bengumasipala wasemakhaya.Imeya yasoLundi, uMnuz Mfana Ntshangase, ithe baphatheke kabi ngokusha kwenxanxathela yezitolo ngoba kulapho abantu basemawadini awu-24 asoLundi bethenga khona.“Siyathemba uphenyo luzocacisa ukuthi umlilo uqalwe yini ngoba kuyashaqisa ukusha kwezitolo. Siyacela abantu bakithi bazithibe bangayi ukuyocosha impahla eshile ngoba bangase bawelwe yisakhiwo njengoba sishile,” kusho uNtshangase.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwabakwa-OK Furnitures ayiphumelelanga ngoba abasekomkhulu labo bengathandanga ukuphawula ngokusha kwesitolo sabo esisoLundi.UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bawutholile umbiko wokusha kwezitolo Olundi kodwa alikho icala elivuliwe futhi nembangela yomlilo ayakatholakali.UMnuz Lennox Mabaso, ophethe ezokuxhumana eMnyangweni kaNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthe kusazophenywa ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi uMasipala wasoLundi ungabi nezinhlelo zokucisha umlilo.“Umnyango usiza omasipala abawu-54 futhi abathengelwa bonke amaloli okucisha umlilo. Kufanele uMasipala wasoLundi uhlele ukuthi uzozibhekelela kanjani izinhlekelele zomlilo. Akufanele uthathe imali ungenzi lutho,” kusho uMabaso.

KUSUKE umsindo phakathi kwamakhansela e-ANC neDA emhlanganweni we-Exco eThekwini izolo mayelana nohambo lukaR2 million oluya emadolobheni amabili aseSouth America, lwezikhulu ophikweni lwezokuthutha kumasipala, osomatekisi nabanikazi bamabhasi.Ithimba labantu abangu-54, elisuka eThekwini, lizoya eSao Paulo eBrazil naseBogota eColombia liyofunda kabanzi ngohlelo lokuphucula ezokuthutha olwaziwa ngeGo Durban. Usuku lohambo lusazohlelwa.Amakhansela eDA ashaya amakhala athi inkulu le mali ezokhishwa wumkhandlu ngalolu hambo.Usihlalo wekhokhasi yeDA eThekwini, uNkk Nicole Graham, uthe bona abahambisani nalolu hambo ngoba luzomosha imali.UNkk Graham uthe uphiko lwezokuthutha eMkhandlwini weTheku ludume kabi ngokuqhuba izinhlelo ezingaphumeleli.“Lolu phiko ayikho futhi into olwake lwayiqala lwayiqeda,” kusho uNkk Graham.Elinye ikhansela leDA, uMnuz Heinz de Boer, lithe noma ngabe kuthiwa le mali ivela kuphi kodwa ngeyabakhokhi bentela.“Kumele kube khona indlela okuzokwenziwa ngayo ukuze kuncishiswe le mali. Abantu abangu-54 baningi kakhulu kungakuhle isibalo sabantu abahambayo sincishiswe,” kusho uDe Boer.Uthe uhulumeni we-ANC uhlala ukhuluma ngokuthi usezinhlelweni zokonga imali kodwa eThekwini iyaxhashazwa.Nomholi wekhokhasi ye-IFP, uMnuz Mdu Nkosi, uhambe emazwini kaDe Boer wathi kumele sincishiswe isibalo sabahambayo.USotswebhu wamakhansela e-ANC eThekwini, uNkk Nelly Nyaniso, uthe bayalweseka lolu hambo ngoba lubalulekile.“Imboni yamatekisi yilona lodwa ibhizinisi labamnyama abazibambele kulona mathupha futhi abaziqalela lona. Leli bhizinisi libambe iqhaza elikhulu emnothweni wezwe. Ngalezo zizathu-ke asisoze sayeka ukuleseka,” kusho uNkk Nyaniso.USomlomo eMkhandlwini weTheku, uMnuz William Mapena, uthe imali ezosetshenziswa iphuma esikhwameni esifanele.UMgcinimafa eThekwini, uMnuz Krish Kumar, uthe uphiko lwabo lwezokuthutha kumele luze kwi-Exco luzocacisa kabanzi ngohlelo lwalo.Uthe uhambo lubalulekile ngoba amazwe avakashelwayo analo uhlelo olufana nolweGo Durban abafuna ukuluqala.
Uma ichweba lingasetshe nziswa ngendlela efanele, wonke umnotho wezwe uya khahlamezeka, ukusuka kwabathumela impahla lapha ekhaya kanye nabathumela impahla kwamanye amazwe kuya kubathengi bempahla.

KUSUKE umsindo phakathi kwamaqembu aphikisayo nezikhulu zikaMasipala weTheku mayelana nesinqumo sokususwa kukaR3.5 million, ezinhlelweni zokukhumbula owayengumengameli wokuqala wentando yabantu kuleli uMnuz Nelson Mandela wayiswa emkhankasweni wokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane ngaphandle kokugunyazwa umasipala.Ikhansela le-IFP uMnuz Mdu Nkosi lithe alingabazi ukuthi le mali isetshenziswe ngaphandle kokugunyazwa umkhandlu.“Ngifisa ukuthola incazelo ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani uR3.5 million, owawabelwe izinhlelo zokukhunjulwa kukaMandela wayiswa kolunye uhlelo ngaphandle kokugunyazwa ngumkhandlu. Uma siqhubeka nokwenza ngeke iphele le nto yokuthi kuthiwe kunezigidi zemali ezisetshenziswe budedengu,” kusho uNkosi.Ikhansela leDA uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, lithe bafuna umuntu othathe lesi sinqumo athathelwe izinyathelo ngoba lokhu akwenzile kuphambene nomthetho wokusetshenziswa kwemali kamasipala.NePhini leMeya uNkk Belinda Scott lithe liyahambisana nesikhalo samaqembu aphikisayo, lengeza ngokuthi kuzomele ajeze umuntu othathe lesi sinqumo.“Kumele siqale sithole ukuthi kuphambene nomthetho yini ukususa imali kolunye uhlelo uyifake kolunye uhlelo, ngolwazi lwami enginalo lokusetshenziswa kwemali kahulumeni kumele kwenziwe isicelo bese kuyagunyazwa,” kusho uNkk Scott.Uthe kumele iphele nya le nto yokusetshenziswa kwemali budedengu.“Umuntu ozotholakala enecala lapho, kuzomele ajeze,” kusho uNkk Scott.IPhini leMenenja oPhikweni lwezoMphakathi nezimo eziphuthumayo uMnuz Vusi Mazibuko okuwuphiko lwakhe oluthathe lesi sinqumo, lithe imali okukhulunywa ngayo ibingakasetshenziswa.UNkk Scott uthe akayikholwa le nto eshiwo nguMazibuko ngoba umkhankaso wokulwa nesihlava sokuhlaselwa kwabesifazane nezingane uqale ngoNovemba 25, uphele ngoDisemba 10.“Akukwazi ukuthi le mali ayikasebenzi ngoba phela uhlelo seluqalile, sizolindela ukuthi sithole umbiko ogcwele emhlanganweni ozayo ukuthi kwenzakalani ngale mali. Embikweni esiwulindeke sifuna le mali icazwe ukuthi izosebenza kanjani,” kusho uNkk Scott.UMgcinimafa eMkhandlwini weTheku uMnuz Krish Kumar, uthe kungenzeka ukuba le mali yasuswa ezinhlelweni zokukhumbula uMandela yayiswa emkhankasweni wokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane kusetshenziswa isigaba somthetho uRule order 28.URule order 28, ilapho imeya nemenenja bethatha isinqumo ngaphandle komkhandlu ngoba bethi kuyaphuthuma.UNkosi uyichithile indaba kaRule order 28, wathi ayikho ngoba akekho umuntu ongathi bekuphuthuma futhi umkhandlu uhleli awukho ekhefini.

KUMISWE ukufunda esikoleni, Ukusa High, eHammarsdale izolo ngemuva kokubulawa konogada ababili okusolwa ukuthi bashaywe bafa begadile ebusuku bangoLwesithathu esikoleni.Isidumbu sikaMnuz Mncedisi Ntuli (29) okuthiwa bekuwusuku lwakhe lokuqala esebenza esikoleni nesikazakwabo uMnuz Thandazani (46) zitholakale kwelinye lamakilasi esikole izolo ekuseni, uzakwabo wesithathu obesaphila uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela elimele kanzima.Kusolwa ukuthi abahlaseli bebefuna ukhiye wegumbi elihlala ama-laptop nezinye izimpahla ezibalulekile zesikole, ongahlali konogada.Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba ngomthombo ongaphakathi esikoleni, unogada ongena ekuseni ufike kukhiyiwe esangweni, wama ngaphandle kwaze kwafika uthishanhloko.“Uthishanhloko uthe unogada makangene ngaphakathi ayobheka ukuthi akukho yini lapho belele khona. Unogada ujombe uthango wangena ngaphakathi wabuya esethi ozakwabo ubafice belele edamini legazi akazi noma kukhona yini kubo osaphila. Uthishanhloko umlandele wangena naye baphuma sebeyofuna abosizo oluphuthumayo,” kusho umthombo.Uyise kaMncedisi, uMnuz Thembinkosi Ntuli, uthe nguye obegqugquzela indodana yakhe ukuthi ingahlali ekhaya isalinde ukuthi kulungiswe okuthile emaphepheni ayo ayigunyaza ukuthi ibe ngunogada ogcwele.“Emasontweni amathathu edlule ungitshele ukuthi uqashwe yinkampani egada ezikoleni, ugada ePhezulu High, bengingazi ukuthi usegada la, eKusa High,” kusho uNtuli.UMfowabo kaThandazani, uMnuz Muntu Majola, uthe akazange asole lutho umfowabo engabuyi emsebenzini ekuseni izolo ngoba kuyenzeka aqale ezindaweni zakhe ngaphambi kokugoduka.“Kuneminyaka egada kulesi sikole akakaze ahlaselwa yize engaphathi lutho oluyisikhali sokuzivikela,” kusho uMajola.UMnuz Mondli Dlamini ongomunye wabanikazi benkampani yonogada iMI Trading ebiqashe labo nogada, uthe sibethuse kakhulu lesi sigameko sokubulawa kwabantu ebebezinikele ekuvikeleni impahla yomphakathi.“Lo msebenzi siwenza ngoba sinothando lomphakathi, akukho nzuzo esiyenzayo yingakho siqasha abantu abangenawo amaphepha ngoba abanamaphepha bazofuna ukukhokhelwa imali esingenayo. Onogada bethu basuke bengahlomile babekelwe ukuthi bafone uma bebona okusolisayo,” kusho uDlamini.Usihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uMnuz Aaron Cele, uthe badumele ngalesi sehlakalo, bebezitshela ukuthi ukuba khona komuntu ogadile esikoleni kuzokwenza izigilamkhuba zisabe ukungena.Unobhala weSadtu kulesi sifundazwe uMnuz Bheki Shandu uthe bahlale belugcizelela udaba lokuphepha ezikoleni emnyangweni, wathi ukubulawa kwalabo nogada kuveze ukuthi kumele ukugada kubhekwe ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani.UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu, obezifikele kulesi sikoleni uthe uphoxeke kakhulu. Uthe kukhomba ukuthi kumele kubuyiswe amakomiti emigwaqo ngoba onogada kabanele ukuthi bagade izikole.“Lokhu kusho ukuthi izingane ezifunda emalokishini nasemakhaya ngeke zithuthuke, ngoba uma kufakwe izinsiza zokuthuthukisa izikole izigebengu ziyangena. Uma kungathiwa onogada abahlome nakhona bazoba sengcupheni yokuhlaselwa kufunwa izibhamu,” kusho uMshengu.Izolo abafundi baphindiselwe emakhaya, uMshengu uthe kuzoze kufundwe ngoMsombuluko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe amaphoyisa athole onogada (29) noneminyaka ewu-46 beshonile ekilasini eceleni kwabo kwatholakala i-crowbar.

IKHALELWE ngamasongo kaSigonyela inyanga yaseMasosheni, eGreytown, okuthiwa ibidlwengula abantu besifazane abakhendla kuyona ibalutha ngokuthi umphambili wayo yilona khubalo eyelapha ngalo, othole wona ngeke aphinde ahlupheke.Inyanga eneminyaka engu-26 esingeke sikwazi ukuyidalula ngoba ayikaveli enkantolo, iboshwe ngoLwesine ekuseni isekhaya layo. Leli phephandaba lihabule ngemithombo yalo ukuthi inyanga ibimatasa ithaka amakhathakhatha ayo ngesikhathi ezakwadalwane zitheleka yathuka, yajuluka yamanzi te bayigaxa izinsimbi bachitheka nayo.Kuthiwa imikhuba yayo isabalele endaweni. Kuyaziwa ukuthi yelapha kakhulu isifazane esitshela ukuthi induku yayo ikhipha amashwa, izinto zaso zikhanye. Kuvele nokuthi uyabagqugquzela ukuthi bazohlalela ngasekhaya lakhe kanti ufuna ukuzitika ngabo ehleli nabo. Umthombo uthi inyanga iboshwa nje sekunabesifazane abebehlala kuyo le nyanga, belashwa besuka esigodini eShana, eGreytown. Kuvela nokuthi laba besifazane bebeze ngosizi lwabo, bengazi ukuthi lo mlisa ubaconsela amathe njengoba behlala naye.Kuthiwa omunye wabo uvule icala lokudlwengulwa njengoba inyanga ligcine liyishonele nje. Akuqondakali ukuthi lo wesifazane ukhuleliswe yiyo yini inyanga noma ukhulelwe kwenye indawo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa kwalo mlisa.Uthe umgilwa ubikele amaphoyisa ukuthi wabhozonyelwa yile nyanga yamdlwengula. Uthe kwavulwa icala eKranskop ladluliselwa ophikweni olubhekene nobugebengu obuhambisana nocansi njengoba ethelekelwe ezakwadalawane, waboshwa."Kulindeleke ukuthi umsolwa avele eNkantolo yeMantshi eKranskop kusasa ebhekene necala lokunukubeza ngokocansi owesifazane oneminyaka engu-25,’’ kusho uColonel Mbele.

WAYEFISA ukuba wunjiniyela uthishanhloko ochonywe uphaphe lwegwalagwala ngokuba wuthishanhloko obadlula bonke ngokuphatha isikole samabanga aphezulu KwaZulu-Natal.UMnuz Philani Innocent Mathenjwa uthishanhloko waseNtulabakayise Secondary, KwaNibela, eHluhluwe, uchonywe uphaphe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu, ngesikhathi ebonga futhi ekhuthaza othisha ngomsebenzi omuhle abawenzile emcimbini owaziwa ngeKwaZulu-Natal National Teaching Awards (NTA) obungoLwesihlanu.UMathenjwa uwine emunxeni we-Excellence in Secondary School Leadership.Uthe ukuba wuthisha kwakungewona umsebenzi ayewuthanda kunayo yonke kodwa wathola ithuba lokuthi awufundele emuva kokuthi ephuthwe yithuba lokuthi afundele iCivil Engineering.Uthe kwakuxhunywana ngokuthi kushayelwe ucingo isitolo esisendaweni bese kushiywa umyalezo wokuthi kumele aye enyuvesi. Ngenxa yokuthi kwakukude nakubo baze bamtshela sesidlulile isikhathi esasibekiwe. Wabe eseyofundela ubuthisha.UMathenjwa uneminyaka ewu-14 enguthisha. Uqale ukuba nguthishanhloko waseNtulabakayise ngo-2016 ngesikhathi lesi sikole sivulwa.Yize enguthishanhloko naye unalo ikilasi alifundisayo njengoba efundisa iMathematics kwaGrade 11 noGrade 12.“Ngiwuthisha weSayensi kodwa ngo-2017 ngiqale ukufundisa iMaths ngoba ngifuna ukubona ukuthi yini le ehlula othisha ekufundiseni iMaths.“Ngaphakathi kimi bekunokuthi uma ngikwazi ukwenza umfundi athande iSayensi, ayiqonde futhi ayiphase kahle yini engangehlula ukuthi nakwiMaths kwenziwe okufanayo.“Ngaqala ngokufundisa uGrade 11 ngaqhubeka nabo ngaya kwaGrade 12 ngoba ngifuna ukuthi uma sengichazela abahloli ngezinselelo engibe nazo ngikhulume ngento nami engiyaziyo.”Lesi sikole siphase ngo-100% nyakenye, kuwo * -60% wamaBachelor, amaDiploma angu-30% no-10% ophase ngeCertificate.UMathenjwa uthe uyena ofika kuqala esikoleni ngo-6.30 aphume ekugcineni ngo-11 ebusuku zonke izinsuku.Uthe unekilasi lokubuyekeza alisizayo elingena ngo-8 kuya ku-10 ebusuku. Abafundi bakwaGrade10, 11 no-12 bavula ngaphambi kokuthi kuvule amanye amabanga ngoba uthi usuke efuna ukuthi babe nesikhathi esanele sokubuyekeza umsebenzi wesikole ngoba isilabhasi bayiqeda ngoJuni.“Uma kuphuma isikole angihambi ngiyahlala ngenze umsebenzi wami ngibe ngizilungiselela isikhathi sokusiza abafundi abangabambi ngokushesha ekilasini. Ngenxa yokuzimisela kwami nabanye othisha sebeze bangijoyina.”Uthe uqale waqhathwa nabanye ozakwabo endaweni, waya esifundeni ngaphambi kokuthi azoqhathwa nabesifundazwe. Kuzwelonke nguye omele iKZN.“Ngijabule kakhulu ngokuchonywa uphaphe ngokwenza kahle. Le ndondo akuyona eyami kuphela kodwa ngeyothisha bonke engibambisane nabo. Thina besisebenza nje singazi nokuthi kuneso elisibhekile,” kuphetha uMathenjwa.UMshengu uthe ukuhlonishwa kwalabo thisha ukubakhuthaza nokubabonga ngomsebenzi omuhle abawenzile kulo nyaka.Uthe uyazi ukuthi abathole izindodo bazoqala unyaka ka-2020 benomfutho ngenxa yezindondo.

AMAPHOYISA axwayisa umphakathi ukuthi uqaphele imisebenzi esolisayo ekhangiswa emaphephandabeni nakwi-internet, eminye yawo eyingxenye yomkhuba wokushushumbiswa kwabantu.UCaptain Khephu Ndlovu okhulumela amaphoyisa eThekwini, uthe kujwayelekile ukuthi kusukela ngoDisemba ibe miningi imisebenzi ekhangiswayo, abanye abazithola sebegilekile ngenxa yayo. Ugcizelele ukuthi abantu balandelele ukuthola kabanzi ngomsebenzi okhangiswayo, ngaphambi kokwenza izinhlelo zokufaka izicelo.“Esihlale sixwayisa ngakho abantu wukuthi awukwazi ukuvele uthole umsebenzi ungakaze usifake isicelo sawo. Ngokujwayelekile uma ufaka isicelo somsebenzi, ugcwalisa ifomu ubizelwe nakwinhlololwazi. Kubalulekile ukubheka yonke imininingwane ngalowo msebenzi nokuthi amahhovisi awo akuphi,” kuchaza uNdlovu.UNdlovu uxwayisa nangokuthi abantu babuze yonke imibuzo ukuze baneliseke ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo somsebenzi.Ngisho kuwumsebenzi waphesheya uthe ikhona indlela yokuwucubungula.“Ungasheshi ujahe umsebenzi kodwa ungacaciselekile kahle ngawo. Akumele ngisho wenze izinhlelo zokuhlangana nomuntu ongamazi. Okunye abantu abakwenzayo ukuthi bafihlele ngisho imindeni yabo ngoba befuna ukubamangaza uma sebethole amadlelo aluhlaza. Ukwazisa othize kuyasiza uma usuzithola usenkingeni. Uma kuwumsebenzi waphesheya, wonke amazwe anamahhovisi amanxsusa awo, okuyiwona angasiza ukukucacisela ngomsebenzi okhangisiwe,” kusho uNdlovu.Kwenzeka lokhu nje lusematheni udaba lowesifazane oneminyaka engu-22 waseKings William Town e-Eastern Cape, otakulwe oKlebe esezoshushumbiswa.Lo wesifazane oyiBeauty Therapist, kuthiwa wabona kukhangiswa umsebenzi kwi-internet, wenziswa inhlololwazi ngeSkype.Ubeselungiselwe ngisho ithikithi lebhanoyi eliya e-Uganda ngoLwesine olwedlule. Unina usolile ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngalo msebenzi, waxhumana noKlebe abathole ukuthi ubeyosebenza kwenye indawo yokudla.OKlebe bamjikise esikhumulweni sezindiza e-OR Tambo eGoli, wabuyiselwa kubo ngeSonto.Okhulumela oKlebe e-Eastern Cape uCaptain Anelisa Femi, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lo wesifazane usebuyiselwe ekhaya.“Uphenyo lusaqhubeka emuva kokuba lo wesifazane kutholakale ukuthi ubehlelelwe ukushushumbiswa. Akekho oseboshiwe kodwa sekutholakele ukuthi ubengaqashelwa umsebenzi obukhangisiwe kodwa ubeyosebenza kwenye indawo yokudla. Amaphoyisa aqale uphenyo ngoba umndeni wakhe ubusola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngalo msebenzi,” kusho uCaptain Femi.

AbeSouth African Revenue Services bathi lo mlingisi ukweleta imali engaphezulu kukaR48 000.Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 13 njengoba abameli bakhe becele ukunikezwa isikhathi sokuthi bake baxhumane nabakwaSARS bahlele ukulungisa lolu daba.USeiphemo waziswe ukuthi lizoqhubeka leli cala uma engaxhumani nabakwaSARS.Abameli bakhe baxolisile bathi usezame kaningi ukuxhumana nabakwaSARS kwangaphumelela.Ngesikhathi inkantolo isahleli lo mlingisi ubebukeka ekhululekile.Ubephelezelwa uzakwabo alingisa naye kwiGenerations, uZoe Mthiyane, olingisa indawo kaZitha othandana noTau kulo mdlalo.Nyakenye ziqinisekisiwe izindaba zokuthi sebeyathandana laba.Lo mlingisi uvela enkantolo ngalolu daba nje, abanye osaziwayo okubalwa kubo umethuli wezinhlelo uBonang Matheba, nomdlali webhola uTeko Modise nabo basobishini nabaqoqi bentela kuleli njengoba nabo bebengayikhokhi intela.

ITHOLAKALE ibulewe yaphonswa esimobeni esiseduze kwasemzini wayo ingoduso ebihlale ihlukunyezwa umnyeni wayo. UNksz Nompumelelo Shangase (46) waseMontebello eNdwedwe ogane eGqugquma, KwaSwayimane utholakale ngeSonto eshonile esimobeni esiseduze komuzi wakhe engenalo inxeba kodwa evuvukele ebusweni, kubonakala sengathi ubeshaywa.Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Nicholas Shangase uthe, washayelwa ucingo umkhwenyana wakwakhe ngeSonto ekuseni ebuza ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ayikaze ifike yini kubo ngoba iduke ngayizolo?“Uthe ushiye amagwinya emafutheni waphuma akamazi ukuthi uyephi usebheke waze wadela, akamtholi. Akuphelanga isikhathi eside wasishayela, wathi utholakale esimobeni esisekupheleni kwegceke emzini wakubo abahlala kuwo,” kusho uShangase.Uthe bafike isidumbu singakathathwa babona ukuthi uma usegcekeni izinyawo zikamufi ziyabonakala emobeni neduku lakhe lasekhanda beliwele khona.“Iyangixaka le nto, kwenziwe yini ukuthi abasemzini womntanami bangamboni umuntu obesobala kangaka? Isidumbu sakhe kubonakala sengathi uqale washaywa, wase waklinywa futhi kubonakala sengathi uphonswe esimobeni eseshonile ngoba akukho okukhombisa ukuthi kuke kwashuduziswana.”Uthe indodakazi yakhe nyakenye ike yalimala kanzima ishaywe umkhwenyana wayo. “Ubehlale eshaywa nguye umyeni wakhe kodwa ebekezele. Incazelo engitshelwa yona ngabasemzini nayo ayingenelisi. Bathi wayepheke amagwinya ngoMgqibelo ebusuku waphuma, wangasho ukuthi uyaphi wangabe esabuya. Bathi akekho ayexabene naye futhi akuzange kube khona ukuhilizisana noma ukulwa nomkhwenyana wakhe. Kuyangixaka lokhu, umuntu onjani ongashiya ibhodwe linamagwinya angasho lutho kumuntu ahleli naye ekubeni amagwinywa kuyinto esheshe ivuthwe noma ngabe ubeya ethoyilethi? Nakuba engeke esavuka umntanami kodwa ngiyafisa ukwazi ukuthi ubulelwe ngubani?" kusho uShangase.UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza, ukhathazekile ngokubulawa komunye umuntu wesifazane.Uqhube wathi: "Nakuba kungakatholakali ukuthi uNksz Shangase ubulewe ngubani kodwa siyazi ukuthi izigameko ezinjengalezi kujwayelekile ukuthi zenziwe ngabantu abasuke bethenjwa kakhulu ngabashonile. Siyethemba ukuthi amaphoyisa azombopha umenzi noma abenzi bokubi masinyane.”UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, okhulumela amaphoyisa, uthe amaphoyisa aseHarburg aphenya icala ngesidumbu sowesifazane esitholakale esimobeni kwaGqugquma, KwaSwayimane ngeSonto. Uthe kusolwa ukuthi lo wesifazane uklinyiwe wabulawa.

Kanjalo nobuholi bezifunda ezintathu okuke kwaba nezehlakalo zokubulawa kwabaholi okuyiHarry Gwala, Moses Mabhida neLower South Coast buhlakaziwe, buzoya kule ngqungquthela kodwa abuvoti.Lokhu kuvezwe nguMxhumanisi wethimba lesikhashana elihola le nhlangano esifundazweni, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, ekhuluma nabezindaba ngamalungiselelo ale ngqungquthela.UZikalala uthe bagculisekile ngoba amagatsha amaningi ahlalile bahlangabezana nokuthi * -70% wamagatsha ukuthi kumele ahlale ukuze kube nengqungquthela. “Angaphezulu kuka-800 amagatsha okuhlolwe ukuthi akulungele yini ukuya engqungqutheleni. Angu-686 aphasile okuyiwona azoya engqungqutheleni. Mabili amalungu igatsha ngalodwa azoya engqungqutheleni.”Uthe ingqungquthela eyamagatsha, wathi sebeyilungele ingqungquthela.Uthe bahlalise izingqungquthela zezifunda eziyisithupha ngempumelelo wathi bese kusele lezi ezintathu ezihlakaziwe. “Wonke amagatsha anikwe ithuba lokuthi alethe izikhalazo zawo. Ubuholi bukazwelonke bebuseMoses Mabhida ibona obuzonquma ukuthi imaphi amagatsha azoya engqungqutheleni.”UNksz Nocawe Mafu, isithunywa sesigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano kulesi sifundazwe, uthe uyajabula ukuthi iyahlala ingqungquthela, wathi uthemba ukuthi izoba yimpumelelo.Ebuzwa ngezinsolo zalabo okuthiwa kabaneme abazomashela ubuholi obusha ngelizayo, uthe akukho abasakutholile.“Akukho esisakutholile mayelana nabantu abathi bazomasha noma abazoya enkantolo ngoba bengeneme. Uma kwenzeka i-ANC iyobhekana nakho ngendlela efanele,” kusho uNksz Mafu.UZikalala uphawule nangokubulawa kwabaholi wathi ngenye yezinselelo ababhekene nayo.“Lezi zehlakalo zenza kube nokungathembani kumalungu. Sisebenzisana nabezomthetho ukuze kunqandwe lesi sihlava kuboshwe abenzi bobubi. Sikholelwa ngukuthi ezobulungiswa zingazinqanda lezi zehlakalo.”Ubuholi besifundzwe bahlakazwa ngemuva kokuba kukhona uhlangothi olwavunwa yinkantolo yaseMgungundlovu ngokuthatha njengento engekho imiphumela yengqungquthela eyakhetha uZikalala njengoSihlalo ngo-2015 eMgungundlovu noMnuz Super Zuma njengoNobhala.Kule ngqungquthela kulindeleke ukuthi uZikalala abuyele njengokugiya kulesi sikhundla, ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kukhulunywa ekaMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, owayekhulumela ubuholi obahlakazwa ophinde abe yiphini likaSotwebhu le-ANC esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe njengoNobhala wesifundazwe.

AMABHIZINISI amancane ayaqhubeka nokuba wumgogodla womnotho yize amaningi ewa kungakapheli iminyaka emithathu esunguliwe.Isikhulu esiphezulu senkampani exhasa osomabhizinisi abancane iFinfind, uNkk Darlene Menzies, sithe kubalulekile ukuthi kusungulwe amabhizinisi ngoba kuzodilizwa abantu eminyakeni emithathu ezayo futhi nasezinkampanini ezizimele wu-22% kuphela wezikhulu eziphezulu othi izinkampani zizokhula kulezi zinyanga eziwu-12 ezizayo.UNkk Menzies uthe osomabhizinisi abaningi abanawo amakhono okubheka izinkampani ezixhasana ngemali futhi abakwazi nokuchaza izinhlelo zabo zebhizinisi uma sebenikwe ithuba.“Izicelo eziningi zoxhaso ziyachithwa ngenxa yokuthi osomabhizinisi abanalo ikhono lokuphatha imali futhi abakwazi ukuchaza kahle ukuthi imali bazoyenzani,” kusho uNkk Menzies.Uthe osomabhizinisi kufanele bahlome ngamakhono azoheha abatshalizimali okubalwa kuwo;- Ikhono lokuphatha imali, elokwazi kabanzi ukuchaza ngebhizinisi, elokuchaza ukuthi imali uyidingelani nomlando wokuthi ibhizinisi lizothuthuka kanjani uma lithola uxhaso.UNkk Menzies uthe abatshalimali bafuna ukwazi ukuthi bazofaka imali yabo ebhizinisini elizophumelela ngoba kubalulekile ukuthi ibuye imali abayitshalile.“Kubalulekile ukuthi usomabhizinisi omncane uma efuna uxhaso acacise ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe lizokhula kanjani nokuthi uma ebolekwa imali ibhizinisi lakhe lizokwazi ukwenza inzuzo ukuze akhokhele isikweletu. Kufanele abe nemininingwane yakhe yemali, izitatimende zasebhange nezeVAT. Ngebhadi osomabhizinisi abaningi abakwazi ukuza nale mininingwane uma beyocela uxhaso ngoba abakwazi ukuziphathela amabhuku nemali. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni bangalutholi uxhaso,” kusho uNkk Menzies.Ube esenika osomabhizinisi abafuna uxhaso lawa masu ambalwa athe azobasiza uma beyofuna uxhaso-Yiba nohlelo lwebhizinisi olucacisayo ukuthi imali liyingenisa kanjani.- Zazi isimo sakho sezikweletu ukuze uma kukhona obakweletayo usheshe ubakhokhele ngaphambi kokuyocela uxhaso lwemali.- Khokhela izikweletu zakho nyanga zonke ngoba abaxhasa ngemali bayabheka ukuthi unegama elinjani kwezezikweletu.- Bhala yonke imininingwane yebhizinisi, imali engenayo nephumayo ngoba lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi uzokwazi ukuphatha imali. Yazi isimo sakho sezimali ukuze ufake isicelo soxhaso lwemali kusasele izinyanga ngaphambi kokuthi uludinge, ungaceli uxhaso ngoba ungasenalutho kwi-akhawunti yakho yebhizinisi.- Zichaze zicace izizathu ezenza udinge uxhaso lwemali, ukhombise nokuthi inkampani yakho ibihweba kahle ngaphambi kokuthi ubone isidingo sokucela uxhaso lwemali.- Cela usizo kungoti ozokusiza ukukwenzela amabhuku, akululeke ngolwazi lwemali nolwentela.UNkk Menzies uthe zingaphezu kuka-200 izinkampani ezixhasana ngemali ezinemikhiqizo engaphezu kuka-500 eyenzelwe osomabhizinisi abancane.Ukuthola abaxhasi, osomabhizinisi abancane bangavakashela ku-www.finfind.co.za

BAZITAPELE izimpahla negilosa emzini kamakhelwane wabo abantu baseChesterville abebemsola ngokubakhokhisa imali abethi eyokugwazela umsebenzi wakwaMasipala weTheku.Izolo, labo makhelwane abebegane unwabu bathe umakhelwane wabo uNkk Cabangile Cele-Zikhali, ubebathembise ukuthi bazoqala emsebenzini ngoMsombuluko. Kuthe sekumele baqale wathi abaye emahhovisi ophiko oluqoqa intela kuleli iSouth African Revenue Service (Sars) bayofuna izinombolo zokukhokha intela.UNksz Nomvula Nyathikazi uthe uNkk Cele-Zikhali oke wasebenza ohlelweni obelwaziwa ngeCato Manor Greening, ubethi uqashwe umasipala ophikweni lwamanzi ngemuva kokuphela kwalolu hlelo ngoDisemba.“Uthe ube nenhlanhla waqashwa wuphiko lwamanzi, nathi asisolanga lutho ngoba ubethi uqale ngoJanuwari. Uthe kulolu phiko kunowesifazane abembiza ngokuthi uLulu, okunguyena onikezwa le mali ayiqoqayo. Ubethi uma sebeqashiwe laba bantu nguyena ozoba yimenenja yabo kodwa uzobe esebenza ngaphansi kukaLulu,” kusho yena.Kuvele ukuthi bangu-36 abathi baluthwe nguNkk Cele-Zikhali kanti umuntu ngamunye ubegwaza ngoR2 000. Iningi labo le mali liyiboleke komashonisa ngoba lithembe ukuthi seliwuthole umsebenzi.UNksz Siziphiwe Mfeka uthe ubeyitoho lapho esebenza khona, wesule emsebenzini wakhe ngoLwesine ngoba etshelwe ukuthi uzohola uR9 000 kwamasipala.“Lo mama ungibulele, ngangihamba naye engiqhuba ethi angesule emsebenzini ngoba sizoqala ngoMsombuluko emsebenzini. NgoMsombuluko sivukele kwaSars njengoba kade eshilo, sihlale khona kwaze kwavalwa elokhu ethi asimlinde uyeza uyolanda imifaniswano yethu. Kulapho sibone khona ukuthi sengathi siqoliwe sabuya seza la emzini wakhe. Ingane yakhe isitshele ukuthi ubekhona ufike wathatha isikhwama wahamba. Simthumelele imiyalezo simtshela ukuthi sizothatha izimpahla emzini wakhe, sizozibuyisa uma eselethe imali yethu,” kusho yena.Kuthiwa uNkk Cele-Zikhali uthumele imiyalezo kubagilwa ethi abalande imali yabo ngo-9 ekuseni, izolo. Abanye ubebasabisa ngokuthi uzobathakatha uma bengayeki ukumthuka. Sebefikile uthe le mali ayikho kuye kodwa ikulo wesifazane okuthiwa uLulu. Ingxenye yaleli qulu ihambe naye yaya ophikweni lwamanzi kumasipala lapho kade ethi lo wesifazane usebenza khona, kwalandulwa kwathiwa akekho umuntu onalelo gama.Ngemuva kwaloku ushintshile wathi kunoR40 000 awubekile komunye umuzi eGlenmore. USAPHITHENE ikhada unina wezelamani ezintathu zaseCaluza, eMgungundlovu, ezibulewe nabazukulu abane ngempelasonto eVlakfontein, eGoli ngempelasonto.UNkk Thoko Khoza ongunina kaNksz Mbali, Dudu noNomfundo Khoza ugcine ukukhuluma nenye yamadodakazi akhe ngesikhathi elungiselela ukuya enkonzweni ngoMgqibelo. Lawa madodakazi akhe abulawe nabazukulu abane bakaNkk Khoza okunguKarabo, Luyanda, Sibongakonke noNkanyiso base begqitshwa endlini nokusolwa obeyisihlobo ebesizenza udokotela ngokubabulala.UNkk Khoza uthe wasola ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngesikhathi eshayela izingane zakhe ucingo kodwa zingazibambi izingcingo. UNkk Khoza uthi uvalo luqale ukumshaya uma engamtholi uMbali kwiselula ngeSonto ekuseni ekubeni ubengalenzi iphutha lokuhamba engamthintanga.“Uvuka kakhulu ekuseni bese siyakhuluma ocingweni. Kodwa ngashaya ucingo isikhathi eside ngingamtholi ucingo luvaliwe. Kukhona engakusola kodwa ngalokhu ngizama ngaze ngashayela uDudu ucingo lwabanjwa yilo mfana ebusuku wathi sebelele bonke uzobatshela ukuthi bengishayela. Ngamangala ngambuza ukuthi yena akalele ngani, wathi usabhala amaphepha omsebenzi asesibhedlela ngoba besazi ukuthi udokotela. Ngisadidekile angisakwazi nakahle okunye,” kusho uNkk Khoza.IMeya yaseMsunduzi uMnuz Themba Njilo ivakashele amalungu alo mndeni izolo. UNjilo uthe umasipala uzobambisana noMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, owezokuThutha, ukuPhepha nokuXhunyaniswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal nowaseGoli ngamalungiselelo okufihla.“UNgqongqoshe waseGoli usesilekelele ngokuthuthwa kwezidumbu, namalungiselelo omngcwabo sesiqalile ukuwenza nomndeni. Sizowulekelela ngakho konke esingasiza ngakho ngoba nogogo siyabona usesele yedwa,” kusho uNjilo. Inkonzo yomngcwabo izoba sehholo lomphakathi eCaluza ngeSonto ngo-9 ekuseni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseGoli uCaptain Mavela Masondo utshele Isolezwe ukuthi basezithendeni zosolwa ngokubulala lawa malungu omndeni.“Amaphoyisa aseLenasia South aphenya amacala ayisikhombisa okubulala kulandela ukutholwa kwezidumbu zabo endlini abebehlala kuyo. Ukhona obethathwe amaphoyisa obehlala kulo muzi ukuze aphoswe imibuzo kodwa wabuya wadedelwa ngoba singakutholi okumhlanganisa namacala. Umsolwa akakaboshwa kodwa silandela umkhondo wakhe. Sinxusa nomphakathi ukuba usilekelele ngolwazi ongaba nalo, uthinte noma yisiphi isiteshi samaphoyisa,” kusho uMasondo.Izidumbu zalaba zitholwe ngoMsombuluko zigqitshwe endlini ngemuva kokuthi abanye abahlala egcekeni lalo muzi bezwe kunephunga elingajwayeleike futhi bengawaboni amalungu alo mndeni.

AKUJWAYELEKILE ukuthi abantu abamnyama bakhombise ukuthandana ngisho sebeguga ngoba kwaziwa ukuthi ngabezinye izinhlanga abenza kanjalo.Kuhlukile kuNkk Thandi Ngonelo (65) nomyeni wakhe uMfundisi Eddie Ngonelo (66), abangabeluleki kwezomshado abangofakazi bokuthi uthando alugugi. Bangabaholi be-Act of Obedience Ministries eThekwini kodwa bayaziwa nakwezinye izifundazwe ngomsebenzi wokweluleka.Sixoxe ngokuthandana kwabo emuva kweminyaka ewu-40 beshadile. Bafike behamba ndawonye emotweni kushayela uMfundisi Ngonelo. Wehle ku­qala uNkk Ngonelo nengubo ephuzi, izicathulo ezisagolilde, wabopha ngomchilo ophuzi igoda eliyi-afro.Babukana emehlweni uma bexoxa bencikene.“Akukona ukuthi konke bekuhamba kahle emshadweni wethu. Indlela ebesixabana ngayo, kukaningi sibona ukuthi idivosi isifanele. Akukho nento etheni esasiyibanga kodwa sasibanga ngisho izinto ezincane,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo.Uthe bahlangana bengakasindiswa kodwa uNkk Ngonelo yena wayevele esonta.UNgonelo uthe enye yezinto ezazibaxabanisa wukuthi wayengafuni umkakhe asonte futhi babehlukene ngokwesikompilo.“Bekuthi njalo uma umkami ezoya esontweni ngimnqabele, aye ngenkani. Bekungicika nokuthi ubenezihlobo eziningi kanti mina ngikhule emndenini omncane. Kuyena bekumnandi ukuvakashelwa yinqwaba yezihlobo ekubeni kanti mina ngifuna sibe naye nezingane kuphela,” kusho uNgonelo.Bathe basizwa wukumenywa kwenye inkonzo yabashadile lapho bafike babona wonke amaphutha abo. Leyo nkonzo yalandelwa enye lapho bazinikela khona basindiswa.“Kuleyo nkonzo kwaba manzi amaduku sikhala. Kwabashadile ababekhona, yithina okwachithwa nathi isikhathi esiningi ngoba kwakonakele,” kusho uNgonelo.Yize bethe izinselelo aziphelanga emshadweni, bafunda ukubekezelelana nokukhulisana. Yilokhu abathi kuhlula abaningi kulezi zinsuku.“Inkinga wukuthi umuntu uqale ahlanyiswe isiqu somuntu bese egijimela umshado engakalazi ingaphakathi lakhe. Ngeke umthole umuntu ongenasici kodwa kumele uqale uzilungise wena. Kunezinto okumele ungazinaki ngoba ngeke uzishintshe. Umshado ukuze uqine kumele ube nezinselelo, ngale kwalokho akuwona umshado. Inkinga wukuthi abantu bajaha ukuphuma emshadweni bengakawazi,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo.Mayelana nokufundana okwaziwa nge-dating, uNkk Ngonelo uthe akunankinga ngisho kubazalwane. Okubalulekile ukugwema ukuya ocansini. Bebuzwa ngokwenza uthando lwabo lungafi, bavele bahleka babukana.“Engangikwenza ngifika emshadweni namanje ngisakwenza. Ngiyezwana nokuhlanzeka futhi ngiyazibambela ekhishini. Ngino-65 kodwa ngizizwa ngimusha kunalokho,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo.Banezingane ezintathu nabazukulu abayisithupha.Ezinye izeluleko zabo:*Musa ukugxeka owakwakho njalo uma kunezinkinga.*Uma usubazi ubuthaka bakhe, zama ukumsiza.*Ngeke umshintshe umuntu kodwa funda ukumbekezelela.*Hlala umuhle njengoba wawunjalo ningakashadi.*Thoba ekhaya ukhohlwe isikhundla onaso emsebenzini nasemphakathini.*Khumbulani ukuthi kunabantu ababukela kinina abafunda umshado wenu.*Ningazami impilo eniyibona kuthelevishini.*Ungasatshiswa wukuphumelela kowakwakho kodwa yazi ukuthi uphakamisa nelakho igama.

text: BAZOZITHOLA zonke izimfanelo zabo abasebenzi baseVBS Mutual Bank abazodilizwa njengoba umuntu obhekelele leli bhange okwamanje ememezele ukuthi abasebenzi bazokwehliswa besuka ku-126 kusale abawu-26 kuphela.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba uNkk Louise Brugman obhekelele ezokuxhumana ehhovisi le-curator, uthe abasebenzi batshelwa ukuthi bazodilizwa ngoMeyi 13 ngesikhathi kwenziwa izinhlelo zokuthi abantu abakade belondoloze imali yabo eVBS bayoyikhipha eNedbank.Uthe abasebenzi bacelwa ukuthi bafake izicelo zezikhala eziwu-26 futhi uhlelo luhamba kahle ngoba sebeqokiwe abawu-25.“Esingakuqinisekisa wukuthi kuzodilizwa abasebenzi abawu-100 kusale abawu-25. Abadiliziwe bazozithola zonke izimfanelo zabo,” kusho uNkk Brugman.Mayelana nokuthi omasipala bazoyithola yini imali ababeyifake eVBS, uNkk Brugman uthe uma sekushaqwe impahla yezikhulu zaseVBS nabanye abahlomule ngokungemthetho kuzobuya uR1.5 billion okusho ukuthi omasipala nalabo ababefake imali engaphezu kukaR100 000 bazoyithola imali yabo.Udonse ngendlebe abakweleta iVBS ukuthi baqhubeke nokukhokha ngoba ukungakhokhi kuzobafaka enkingeni.U-Adv Terry Motau oze nombiko oveza ukuthi kunabantu abahlomule ngokungemthetho eVBS uthe akasabi lutho njengoba sekukhona abasabisa ngokumbopha.Ekhuluma ne-IOL uMotau uthe, “Angikhathazekile ngalabo abasabisa ngokungithathela izinyathelo zomthetho ngoba ngiyabona ukuthi abakaze bawufunde umbiko wami. Angikaze ngithi kunomuntu onecala kulo mbiko. Engikushilo wukuthi kunemali eyaphuma ebhange, yakhokhelwa abantu abathile, ngasho nokuthi bathole malini. Akekho engithe unecala.”Khonamanjalo, Isilo samaVenda uToni Mphephu Ramabulana, sithi sizoyikhokha yonke imali okubikwa ukuthi sayithola kutanyuzwa imali yeVBS Mutual Bank ngokungemthetho.Kubikwa ukuthi uMphephu Ramabulana wathola uR17 million kuleli bhange. NgeSonto uMphephu uveze ukuthi uzimisele ukuyikhokha le mali uma kuwukuthi wayithola, okuyinto ayichithayo ukuthi yenzeka.“Kuyishwa ukuthi * -Adv Motau neWerksman Attorneys bakubona kungenasidingo sokuthi nginikezwe ithuba lokuveza olwami uhlangothi. Ngokwazi kwami awukho uR17 million engakhokhelwa wona. Anginakho ukungabaza ukuthi uMotau nabeWerksmans Attorneys bayazi ukuthi ukuvela kwegama lami kulo mbiko kusilimaza kanjani isithunzi sami ngokunjalo nobuKhosi baseVenda. Ngifanelwe ukuphathwa kangcono,” kusho uMphephu Ramabulana encwadini ayibhalele isizwe sakhe.Uphinde waveza ukuthi miningi iminikelo ayithola kubantu abahlukene.Uthe uma kukhona imali ayithola kudliwa imali yaseVBS Mutual Bank, wayithola engazi ukuthi iphume ngomkhonyovu.“Ngiyazibophezela ukukhokha imali uma kunobufakazi bokuthi yaphuma ngezindlela ezingafanele, uma isibaliwe ukuthi malini eyaphuma ngomkhonyovu ngizoyikhokha,” usho kanje.Uzwelane kakhulu nabantu abaphazamisekile ngokudliwa kwemali eVBS Mutual Bank esho nokuthi wayengazi ukuthi kunomkhonyovu kuleli bhange.Namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi i-EFF iphendule ngezinsolo zokuthi nayo yadla ngesikhathi kwebiwa imali esondele kuR2 billion eVBS.Lolu daba luphinde luthinte abaholi ababili abaphezulu be-ANC eLimpopo.Izolo ubuholi be-ANC kulesi sifundazwe bebuhlangene nobuholi obuphezulu be-ANC eLuthuli House buzocacisa ngokwenzeka eVBS.

Mina ngiyinsizwa yomZulu esakhuzela uma ibona intombi eyithandayo.”Uthe nasemandulo kunamadoda kaNkulunkulu ayenenqwaba yezancinza.“Mina angiholwa yizwi kodwa ngilandela umgomo wakwaNdwandwe. Mina nganikezwa izwe kwathiwa angibuse kulo.”UNdwandwe uthe iningi labazalwane liyamjabulela ngoba wenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabo.Kodwa ngesikhathi leli phephandaba likhuluma namanye amalungu aleli bandla, asho okwehlukile.“Abanye bethu abaneme neze ngoba sikhonza namadodakazi ethu.Njengoba siyibandla labasindisiwe nje, akuzwakali kahle ukuthi umfundisi wethu unesithembu futhi aphinde abe noxhaxha lwezintombi.”Ukuthola ukuphawula kwamakhosikazi kaNdwandwe kugcine kungaphumelelanga.

text: ZIKHIHLA esikaNandi izakhamuzi zaseNkunzi, eMnambithi, ezifelwe yizinkomo ezidle ushevu okuthiwa uthelwe wumuntu ongaziwa edlelweni zasala ziqumbile. Uthi kuvele kwaduma ikhanda ngoba izinkomo uzithatha njengensika yekhaya lakhe.“Uma unezinkomo uyakwazi ukuthi uma kukhona okuvelayo udayise inkomo upheshe leso sikweletu. Ngifuyile impela ngoba kukhona nezamadodana ami asekhulile, manje le nto isibuyisela emuva,’’ kubalisa uMavimbela.UMnuz Nkosenye Mazibuko naye obeklabise ezakhe izinkomo endaweni efanayo, uthe kufe ezingu-6.“Sithole ukuthi kukhona umuntu ochithe ukudla kwezinkomo okuthakwe noshevu ngoba uma inkomo idlile bekungathathi isikhathi eside ibonakale ingqasha iwa phansi. Iwusizo inkomo thina singabantu sigcina amasiko sihlabe kube nemisebenzi,’’ kuchaza uMazibuko ngokukhathazeka.Bathe umasipala wendawo ufikile uzobheka isimo kwatholakala ukuthi sekuvele konakele kodwa bazigqiba izinkomo ezinye bazithatha zayohlolwa.Okhulumela uMnyango wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Phathisa Mfuyo, uthe bawutholile umbiko bawathatha amasampula ukuyohlola ukuthi yini edliwe yizinkomo.

SELUNGENELELWE uNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka kuzwelonke uTokozile Xasa udaba olusematheni lokuduba uhlelo lwethelevishini bukhoma kowayengumdlali wamaBhokobhoko, u-Ashwin Willemse ngoba ecikwa ukubhuqwa uNaas Botha noNick Mallet.UXasa ukhiphe isitatimende izolo emini emuva kwalesi senzo esenzeke ngoMgqibelo ebusuku uWillemse, Botha noMallet bebesohlelweni olushayelwa uMotshidisi Mohono, kuhlaziywa imidlalo yeVodacom Super Rugby.UWillemse utshele uBotha noMallet (abebedlala ngezikhathi zobandlululo) ukuthi ngeke akumele ukusebenza nabantu abambukela phansi ngokwebala lakhe. Uthe ngeke akwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza nabantu belokhu bembhuqa ekubeni babedlala ngezikhathi zobandlululo.“Kusukela ngaqala ukuzikhulisa ekuziqeqesheni njalo ningibuka njengomdlali owafakwa ngenxa yebala lakhe,” kusho uWillemse ngaphambi kokubalula injabulo yakhe ngokuthi konke lokhu okwenzekayo umhlaba uyabuka kwazise bekubukhoma.Ungqongqoshe uthe: “Le ndlela yokuziphatha kwabathile bebala elimhlophe ngokuzitshela ukuthi ubumhlophe babo busho ukuthi bangcono, kufanele iphele. Ukube akubona ubulwane obabuhambisana nenzondo enkulu yabamnyama ngabe asibanga khona isidingo sokuthi kuze kulwelwe ukuthi isibalo sabamnyama silingane nesabamhlophe,” kusho uXasa.Ukhumbuza izwe lonke ukuthi uWillemse udelelwa nje, akayena umdlali wamaBhokobhoko ojwayelekile kodwa ngo-2003 waqokwa waba iSA Rugby Player of the Year, Young Player of the Year nePlayer’s Player of the Year. Omunye ubenamanxeba awu-6, omunye bamdubule kawu-7,” kusho uKhwela ekhathazekile.Eqhuba uthe sebesabela impilo yabo ngoba kuyacaca abaphephile kulo mndeni kulandela izigameko eziningi ezimbi ezenzeka zilandelana.UBULAWE ezoya komela isikole emdlalweni omkhulu webhola uMxolisi MzimelauNkosingiphile Vilakazi (15) obefunda uGrade 10 eMargot Fonteyn SecondaryEchaza laba ababulelwe uthe bekuyizingane ezilalelayo futhi ezithobekile ngisho esikoleni othisha bebehlala bezincoma.“UMxolisi izolo bekumele ayodlala ibhola nesikole njengoba kuse esebulewe. Izinhliziyo zethu zibuhlungu, sihlukumezekile kodwa akukho esingakwenza ngaphandle kokwamukela isimo esehle layikhaya,” kusho uKhwela.Lo mndeni wehlelwa yilo mshophi nje ubusanda kuba ondabuzekwayo kulandela ukunqoba kwelinye lama lungu omndeni iDusi Canoe Marathon, uSbonelo Khwela.Izinhlelo zomngcwabo bezingakahlelwa njengoba leli phephandaba likhulume nomndeni isigameko sisanda kwenzeka.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko.“Bebehleli endlini ngesikhathi behlaselwa abasolwa ababili abangaziwa babadubula. Abezimo eziphuthumayo baqinisekisile ukufa kwabo endaweni yesigameko. Okwamanje ibingakaziwa imbangela yokubulala. Kuvulwe icala lokubulala, amaphoyisa aKwaNdengezi ayaphenya,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.
