UKUNGENELISEKI ngeholo athi ubengakwazi ukwenza zonke izidingo zakhe kuholele ekutheni owesifazane waseMlaza athathe isinqumo sokuvula elakhe ibhizinisi.UNksz Zinhle Mshengu ongumsunguli wenkampani ekhiqizela izinkampani imifaniswano nezimpahla ezigqokelwa ukuphepha emsebenzini, Ikhethelo Clothing and Textile eseMlaza, uthe ngesikhathi evula inkampani wayefuna ukuthola imali engcono kunaleyo ayeyihola emsebenzini.UNksz Mshengu owasebenza ehhovisi kwamasipala uthe, wabona ukuthi angakwazi ukwenza into ezomphonsela inselelo kunokwenza umsebenzi wasehhovisi ayewuqashelwe owawungamanelisi ngeholo.“Bengehluleka ukukhokhela zonke izikweletu zami uma kuphele inyanga, ngaphezu kwalokho kumele ngiphe abazali bami imali. Lokhu kukhathazeka kwenza ukuthi ngizihlole ukuthi ayikho yini indlela engingaphuma ngayo. Isu elaqhamuka elokuthi ngivule inkampani yami. Ucwaningo engalwenza lwangikhombisa ukuthi uma ngingqongqoza eminyangweni efanele ngizoluthola uxhaso, ekupheleni kwenyanga ngithole imali engcono. Ngaqala ngokuthi ngingene emkhakheni wamathenda,” kusho yena.Ngo-2012 kuya ku-2014 uthe ungene emkhakheni wamathenda wathola umsebenzi wokuthi athengele izibhedlela zaseMpumalanga izingubo zokulala nezingubo ezigqokwa yiziguli.Uqhube wathi ngesikhathi enza lokhu wayefuna izinkampani lapho ezothenga khona bese edayisela umasipala. Wathola ukuthi ayikho inkampani yomuntu wesifazane omnyama angathenga kuyo. Ezikhona wabona ukuthi azikwazi ukukhiqiza umthamo odingekayo uma zithola i-oda elikhulu.“Ngabona ithuba lokuthi ngivule inkampani ngisebenze nabantu besifazane sibe yinkampani ekhiqizela izinkampani izingubo zokusebenza nemifaniswano kanjalo nezingubo zokulala. Ngahambisa umbono wami kwaSAB bawubona uphusile bangixhasa,” kusho yena.Kule nkampani uthe kusebenza abesifazane kuphela bonke baneminyaka engaphansi kuka-35.Nyakenye ungenele umncintiswano wabantu abasha abanamabhizinisi enza kahle ohlelwa yiSAB, waphuma ku-top-21 ezweni lonke.INGAPHAKATHI lendawo ekhiqiza imifaniswano nezimpahla zokusebenza, Ikhethelo Clothing and Textile eseMlaza Isithombe: Sithunyelwe“Ibhizinisi lokukhiqiza impahla ngingene kulona ngo-2017. Nyakenye ngiqokwe ngaba ngomunye wosomabhizinisi abenza kahle ababili. Ukuqokwa kungenze ngabona ukuthi ngempela ngiwusomabhizinisi osenganyukela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngemuva kwalokho ngivakashelwe ngongoti bokukhiqizwa kwezimpahla ezenziwe ngendwangu baseNerthelands bezobona indawo engisebenzela kuyo, baphinde bangicobelela ngolwazi lokukhulisa umkhiqizo wami,” kusho yena.Uthe bamsiza ngokuthi indawo yakhe ayihlele ngendlela ezokwenza ukuthi akhiqize ngendlela eyiyo.Muva nje uthe usebenzisana nenye inkampani ekhiqiza ama-duvet, amashidi nezinye izinto zokulala zikanokusho.“Lezi zimpahla sizokwazi ukuzidayisa emazweni aphesheya. Amakhasimende athenga lezi zimpahla ngabantu abangenqeni ukukhipha imali futhi abangazithandi izinto ezifana nezabanye. Kubo sibala namahhotela aphambili,” kusho yena.

text: UKUQOKWA kukaMnuz Bheki Cele esikhundleni sokuba nguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kujabulise abaningi abebelokhu bekhale njalo uma kwenzeka ubugebengu bethi akubuyiswe uCele, ngakolunye uhlangothi kunalabo abanovalo nongabazane ngobuholi bakhe, uDELI MNCWABE uyahlaziyaSEKUNGUMLANDO ukuthi kuphelile ngoNgqongqoshe obemandla nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, kwangena oke waba nguMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele obelokhu ekhaleleka njalo uma kuvela ukuthi izigebengu ziyazicanasela eNingizimu Afrika.Yize iningi likhombise ukujabula kodwa umlando wakhe ngesikhathi enguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eminyakeni edlule, ubuyise uvalo nongabazane ngobuholi bakhe kwabaningi.Okhulumela inyunyana yamaphoyisa iPopcru, uMnuz Richard Mamabolo uthe bayakwemukela ukuqokwa kukaCele, wathi bayazi ukuthi uhlalelwe umqansa ongenyukwa mbongolo njengoba kufanele asebenze kanzima ukubuyisa isithunzi sezokuvikela.“Siyakwemukela ukuqokwa koNgqongqoshe abazosebenza emkhakheni wezokuphepha. Siyazi ukuthi uCele akamusha kulo mkhakha. Useke wasebenza njengokhomishana, isipiliyoni sakhe asithola ngokudlula sizomsiza ukungena athi khaxa asebenze kushunqe uthuli.“Okukuqala okufanele akwenze wukudiliza inqwaba yezikhulu kuzwelonke nasezifundazweni, aphinde aqinisekise ukuthi anele amaphoyisa eziteshini,’’ kusho uMamaboloAkumangazi ukubonakala kwezithombe zikaCele nama-video edansa abantu bejabuliswa yisinqumo sikaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Eqokwe ngayizolo uCele, ufike lazwakala izwi lakhe njengoba ekade ehambele inkonzo yesikhumbuzo samaphoyisa aseNgcobo.“Akumele nife niphethe izibhamu,” waphinde watshela amaphoyisa la mazwi ake wawasho phambilini ukuthi amaphoyisa kumele ashaye enyameni kwizigilamkhuba.I-DA ikhuze umhlolo ngokubuyiswa kukaCele yathi kuyichilo eliphindiwe. UMnuz Zakhele Mbhele obhekele ezamaphoyisa uthe akasiboni isidingo sokubuyiswa kukaCele emaphoyiseni.“Kuyethusa ukuthi umuntu owake watshela amaphoyisa ukuthi awadubule enyameni ezigebengwini usebuyisiwe. Sihlala sigcizelela ukuthi umbutho wamaphoyisa udinga ukuphathwa abantu abafanele,’’ kusho uMbhele.Kunenkolelo yokuthi uCele uyaziswacisa izigebengu ngamazwi nangemiyalelo ayinika amaphoyisa.Nokho akhona amaphutha nogcobho ababonwa yilabo abangaphakathi emaphoyiseni, abakholwa wukuthi umuntu okulesi sikhundla kumele kube wumuntu osemnkantshubomvu emaphoyiseni.Kwamanye amaphutha akhonjwa kuCele, kubalwa udaba okukholakala ukuthi lwamxoshisa ekubeni wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, kubalwa udaba lokuthengwa kwesakhiwo samaphoyisa, nalapho owayenguMvikeli woMphakathi, * -Advocate Thuli Madonsela athi ingcabha yayikuCele ngalolu daba.Okunye okumdalele amazinyo abushelelezi yizinkulumo zakhe. Kuzona kubalwa ayenza ngesikhathi kuphenywa kabanzi icala lokubulawa kuka-Annie Dewani nokwakusolwa umyeni wakhe uShrien ngokumbulalela kuleli. Lolu daba lwagcina ukunakwa kusekhona uCele ngemuva kwalokho kwathuleka ngalo kwagcinwa kuboshwe uXoli Mngeni noMziwadoda Qwabe kwathi owayesolwa phambili uDewani waphunyula.UCele wabiza umsolwa ngenkawu esuke ezweni layo yazogila ubugebengu lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu akwehlanga kahle kwabaningi. Kwaphoqa ukuthi agcine ehlele ngezansi axolise ngenkulumo yakhe.Enye inkulumo ngeyokugqugquzela amaphoyisa ukuba adubule ashaye enyameni ezigebengwini, abuze emva kwendaba.Olunye udaba kube ngolombutho owaziwa ngeleTRT (amabherete) ake asolwa ngobuge-bengu nokungaziphathi kahle. Indlela abesebenza ngayo ibishiya imibuzo nezinsolo zokunga-hambisi kahle.Ubudle-lwano obuqinile phakathi kukaCele bubonakale ngisho esephumile esikhundle-ni sokuba ngukhomi-shana njengoba ake wakho-mbisa ukuweseka amanye awo ngesikhathi evela eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini eyoqula icala.Lokhu kukhombise ngokusobala ukuthi nakuba kwake kwakhona umsindo wokuthi akakaze abe yiphoyisa njengoba aye ngumkhuzi wawo, kodwa ukusebenza ngokuzimisela nokuba ngumuntu okwazi ukuxhu-mana nalo mbutho, kwenze waba ngumuntu ogcina ethenjwa yiwo.Phezu kwakho konke lokhu iningi labantu lithi uCele ubenza okufanele futhi unguMesiya ozokhipha umphakathi wakuleli ebugqileni obudalwa wukudlanga kobugebengu.Ubufakazi wukuthi ngesikhathi engukhomishana wamaphoyisa wenze umphakathi waphila ngokuphepha ngenxa yokuthi ubugebengu bubonakale behla.UCele waziwa ngokuzibambela mathupha efika endaweni yesigameko azibophezele ekuxazululeni inkinga nokuhambela imiphakathi abheke ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ebhekene nazo.Nakuba nabanye bekwenza kodwa okukaCele kuyadlulela nokungenye yezinto emenze wathandwa ngabantu.Akekho ongakhohlwa ukuthi uCele uphinde abe nendaba nendlela amaphoyisa abukeka ngayo. Lokhu kubonakale ngesikhathi egqugquzela ukuthi awajime futhi akhece imikhaba, kugqame isifuba.Phakathi kobugebengu obebudla lubi kulezi zinsuku kubalwa ukuqolwa kwezimoto ezithwala imali.Nakuba kungakapheli ngisho isonto kodwa uCele usephawulile ngalokhu wathi ngesikhathi sakhe waqeda ngalolu hlobo lobugebengu. Uthe uzibophezele ukuqeda nya ngabo nangobunye obuphilisa lubhojozi umphakathi.Ukubuya kwakhe azohlenga isizwe yinto osekunesikhathi ikhaleleka. Lokhu kubonakale ngemikhankaso ethi #BringBhekiCele ne-#BringNdosiBack ebishisa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Kwayena ubelibeka ngembaba elokuthi uyakhumbula futhi usawulobizela lo msebenzi. Ngamanye amazwi inkulumo ayenza emngcwabeni wowayengumsakazi uNat “Cool Kat” Gumbi, lapho athi ukhathele wukujahana namaklabishi, ufuna ukujaha izigebengu, lifezekile.

Izikhungo zokuhlanza amanzi olwandle ukuze asetshenziswe ngabantu emakhaya nasema bhizinisini, izinhlelo zokulungi swa kwamapayipi, ukusetshenzi swa kabusha kwamanzi kanye nohlelo lokumbiwa kwamanzi emhlabathini sekuhlonzwe njengesisombululo kule nkinga,

BAKHALA bayazithulisa abadayisi basemgwaqweni ePinetown emuva kokuthi umlilo okusolakala ukuthi uqalwe amaphara ushise impahla abayidayisayo yaba wumlotha ezintatha zayizolo.UNkk Philomena MaMthembu Hlophe ophethe indawo okugcinwa kuyo impahla yabadayisi basemgwaqweni u-Anderson phakathi kwerenke yaKwaNdengezi neyaseClermont, ePinetown uthe ushayelwe ngamaphoyisa amtshela ukuthi kuyasha ngabo-2 ezintatha zayizolo.“Ngishayelwe izicishamlilo safika kanye nazo la ePinetown. Zizamile ukucisha kodwa ngebhadi ayikho impahla esindile njengoba konke kushe kwaba wumlotha. Saqala ngabo-1980 ukudayisa ezitaladini zasePinetown kodwa siyaqala ukubhekana nesimo esinzima kanje. Kusolakala ukuthi umlilo uqalwe yilaba abahlala kujantshi wesitimela kusho ukuthi bebebasile wase umlilo ubhebhetheka ushisa impahla lapha,” kusho uNkk Hlophe.Ucele noma wubani ongaba nosizo ukuba alekelele abadayisi abashelwe yimpahla ikakhulukazi uMasipala weTheku esho nokuthi akukho lapho abadayisi bethatha khona.Abadayisa izinkukhu oNksz Magaret Hadebe (54), Nksz Borcas Phakathi (56), uNkk Thandi Mabaso (69) noMnuz Mzingelwa Gama (79) bebekhalela izinkukhu zabo ezishe ziphila zaba ngamalahle.“Awukwazi nokubona ukuthi bekuyinkukhu enjani, zife zaphela izinkukhu zethu . Sicela uMasipala weTheku usinxephezele ngoba siyarenta ukugcina impahla yethu lapha. Sikhokha uR40 ngesonto noR400 wephemithi yezinyanga eziyisithupha. Siziphilisa ngokudayisa izinkukhu asazi sizokwenzenjani ngoba silahlekelwe yimpahla kaR2 000 umuntu emunye,” kusho uNksz Hadebe.UMnuz Jackson Rooimes owenza izicathulo, azikhande aphinde adayise nezintsha, uthe ulahlekelwe yimpahla kaR80 000 ngoba ubesanda kuthenga impahla yenyanga futhi kunezicathulo zabantu ezibizayo abezozilungisa kodwa ezishile. Kuyimanje angazi ukuthi ngizothathani ngiyihlanganise nani ngoba abantu bazozifuna izicathulo zabo,” kusho uRooimes.Uthe unezingane ezine azondla ngokudayisa emgwaqweni njengoba eyokugcina ineminyaka emibili.Ucele uMasipala weTheku ukuthi ubanxephezele ngoba abanawo umshwalense wosomabhizinisi kwazise basebenzela ukuxosha ikati eziko.Uveze ukuthi ngesonto ubekhokha uR70 ukugcina impahla yakhe kule ndawo eshile bese eba nephemithi kaR139 yezinyanga ezintathu.UMnuz Craig Peters oyi-Acting Divisional Commander ePinetown Fire and Emergency Department, uthe abasebenzi ababheka amaCCTV kaMasipala weTheku babone umlilo otshanini obungakujantshi wesitimela kwathi izicishamlilo seziphuthuma khona zezwa umsindo wento eqhumayo, kwase kusha amalangabi.Uthe kushe amaveji, inyama, iziphuzo, izinkukhu, izingubo zokugqoka nokunye.Ikhansela lendawo uNkk Mel Brauteseth lithe lisola ukuthi amaphara yiwona aqale umlilo ngoba egodola kodwa ahluleka ukuwulawula njengoba ushise impahla yabahwebi basemgwaqweni.“Bekukhona izitofu zegesi eziwu-40, izinkukhu ezilinganiselwa ku-80 nempahla ehlukene. Yonke into ishe yaba amalahle, ” kusho uNkk Brauteseth.UCaptain Nqobile Gwala wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uthe ukhona umlilo oshise impahla yabadayisi basemgwaqweni, akekho olimele.UMnuz Msawakhe Mayisela okhulumela uMasipala weTheku uthe imbangela yomlilo ayaziwa kodwa kuthiwa uqale ngakujantshi wesitimela wagcina usushisa indawo egcina impahla yabadayisi basemgwaqweni.Uthe bangaphezu kuka 300 abadayisi akade bebeka impahla engabiza uR300 000 kuleya ndawo.“Kukhona ingqalasizinda yakwaMTN yentengo kaR17 million neyakwaVodacom esingakayitholi intengo yayo,umonakalo owenzekile kwingqalasizinda kamasipala ulinganisela kuR9 million,”kusho uMayisela.

Kusolakala ukuthi umufi ushaywe amalungu omphakathi ngoba ezama ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko emuva kwengozi. Kusolakala nokuthi ngesikhathi engaphandle komtholampilo endaweni yokupaka umsolwa uhlule iphoyisa ngamandla wathatha isibhamu salo wazidubula ekhanda ngesikhathi elinye lingaphakathi emtholampilo,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini ka-Abdolo athe kuthiwa ubentshontshe imoto yakubo ngesikhathi ebandakanyeka engozini.Uthe batholile ukuthi usizwe amaphoyisa amyisa emtholampilo waseGamalakhe nokuyilapho obekulindeleke ukuthi ahlolwe igazi ukuze kuvele ukuthi ubengaphuzile yini amanzi amponjwana. UDhlomo uchaze lesi sigameko njengesishaqisayo.“Sidabuke kakhulu ngalesi sigameko sokulahlekelwa umphefumulo wumuntu osemusha ngokungenasidingo. Akucabangeki ukuthi abazali bakhe babhekene nobuhlungu obungakanani kulesi sikhathi. Akulula ukubhekana nesimo sokushonelwa yingane ngenxa yento eqale iwukuganga yagcina seyiyinhlekelele enjena,” kusho uDhlomo.Uthe bayazi nokuthi bakhahlamezeke kangakanani abantu abebekhona ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko emtholampilo waseGamalakhe njengoba ethe babafisela ukuthi bathole amandla kuNkulunkulu ukuthi abasize babhekane nalesi simo. Uthe bazobasiza nalabo abadinga ukululekwa ngokomqondo. Unxuse namalungu omphakathi ukuthi akugweme ukuzijezisela abantu.Izolo, umalume ka-Abdolo, uMnuz Phumlani Mdlozini, uthe umndeni usesimeni esingesihle emuva kokwenzekile.Uthe akulula ukuthi bangakhuluma kakhulu ngakho ngoba kuphenywa wuphiko oluphenya amacala enziwa amaphoyisa Independent Police Investigative Directorate.Ngokusho kwakhe, umshana wakhe ube sengozini yemoto wase ehlaselwa amalungu omphakathi nokuyilapho okufike khona amaphoyisa amthatha amuyisa emtholampilo okuyilapho okwenzeke khona lesi sigameko.UMdlozini uthe umshana wakhe ubethathe imoto yakubo eyoyilungisa ngesikhathi kwenzeka ingozi.

Uthe kade kwasa bezicelela ukuba uhulumeni asukumele usizi lwamasosha okuthiwa awanakiwe kodwa ayelwela inkululeko yezwe. Uthe kufanele amasosha anakwe ngoba izwe lilapho likhona ngenxa yeqhaza alibamba emzabalazweni.“Bonke kufanele bathole izinombolo zasembuthweni bafakwe ohlwini lwamasosha kube khona abakutholayo nemindeni yabo. Ngake ngakucela lokhu, ngiyaphinda futhi ngiyakucela nanamuhla ngiyethemba kuzwakele. Nginalo ithemba lokuthi kuzofika nasesigungwini esiphezulu sikaKhongolose, kusho uMavundla. Ubekhuluma kanjena nje sekunomkhuba odlangile KwaZulu-Natal wokuthi amasosha oMkhonto Wesizwe aphazamise ukusebenza komasipala ekhala ngokuthi avalelwa ngaphandle abulawa yindlala. UDhlomo uwanxusele amasosha wathi akufanele alahlwe.“Amanye amasosha engike ngixoxe nawo asuke ekhala izinyembezi ngempela. Kufanele kube khona okwenziwayo naye uSihlalo uMavundla ngimphathisa umphako wokuthi ahlanganise amasosha abumbane esifundazweni kungabibikho amaqembuqembu amasosha,’’ kusho uDhlomo.Uthe ukubuyiswa kwamathambo kudala isidingo sokuthi kuqhutshekwe kuthungathwe nabanye abaningi abaduka ngezikhathi zomzabalazo babuyiselwe emindenini yabo.Okhulumela iMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Mthunzi Gumede, utshele abezindaba ukuthi uMasipala weTheku uvele uphezu kwezinhlelo zokuthi kwakhiwe indawo ezogcina amagugu omlando wamasosha.“Le ndawo izoba njengendawo yokuvakasha lapho sizobe sibhale khona amagama azo zonke izishoshovu ukuze kugcineke umlando.’’

KUCHAZWE njengokuwa kwensika ukudlula emhlabeni kwesishoshovu se-ANC, uMnuz Mendi Msimang, odlule emhlabeni izolo ngemuva kokugula isikhathi eside.UMsimang, owayeyiHigh Commissioner yase-United Kingdom (UK), uchazwe njengengqalabutho eyalwela amalungelo abantu. Ungumyeni kaDkt Manto Tshabalala-Msimang, owayenguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo owadlula emhlabeni ngo-2009.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa udlulise amazwi endunduzo emndenini, kubangani, izihlobo nakubantu bakuleli ngokudlula emhlabeni kwalesi sishoshovu esamela i-ANC eLondon ngo-1960.Uthe uMsimang wabuya ekumeleni le nhlangano wabe esejutshwa e-UK ngowayengumengameli wezwe uDkt Nelson Mandela.“Sigobisa amakhanda sikhumbula ubaba Mendi Msimang ngoba izwe lilahlekelwe kakhulu ngaleli qhawe. Ukudlula kwakhe kumele kugqugquzele wonke umuntu ukuthi azigqaje ngomlando siphinde sihloniphe nezingqalabutho esezadlula.”URamaphosa uthe imininingwane yomngcwabo izokhishwa uma uhulumeni esebonisene nomndeni kanjalo ne-ANC.UMsimang ubeyilungu lekomiti elibhekela ukuziphatha kwi-ANC futhi esekomitini eliluleka ngokuthi obani okumele bahlonishwe ngumengameli kanti uke waba ngumgcinimafa wale nhlangano.Okhulumela i-ANC, uMnuz Pule Mabe, uthe kuwe insika ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaMsimang.Uthe ubeyilungu lale nhlangano iminyaka eminingi kanti wake waba nayilungu lophiko lwentsha.“Sishaqekile ngokudlula emhlabeni kwalesi sishoshovu ebesaziwa ngomalume Mendi. Wasebenza nezingqalabutho ezingoWalter Sisulu nezinye kwi-ANCYL.”Uthe wasebenza eqeqeshelwa umsebenzi enkampanini yabameli kaNelson Mandela no-Oliver Tambo.Waya ekudingisweni ngo-1961 ngesikhathi i-ANC ivalwa umlomo. Wabuya ezweni waqokelwa esigungwini esiphezulu se-ANC ngo-1991. Waba yilungu lePhalamende ngo-1994 waphinde waba nguSihlalo wekhokhasi ye-ANC ePhalamende.Waqokelwa kwesikamgcinimafa we-ANC ngo-1997 engqungqutheleni yaseMafikeng lapho owayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Thabo Mbeki aqokelwa kwesikamengameli we-ANC. Waba ngumgcinimafa kwaze kwaba ngu-2007.Ngo-1999 uMsimang wahlonishwa ngendondo yesiliva nguMandela nezinye izishoshovu zomzabalazo.“Siyamhlonipha ngemisebenzi yakhe nokuzinikela ezweni. Sizoqhubeka sigubhe ubuholi namava akhe sigcine negama lakhe emlandweni ukuze izizukulwane zifunde ngaye,” kusho uMabe.Ne-UDM ngomlomo kaMengameli wayo uGeneral Bantu Holomisa ibhonge emswanini yadlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini kaMsimang.“Kumele simhloniphe ngokuthi sithuthukise impilo yabantu. Kumele siqede imijondolo sithuthukise ezempilo ukuze simhloniphe ngendlela ngoba ubengumuntu osezingeni elifanayo noMandela,” kusho uHolomisa.UNobhala jikelele weSaftu, uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi, naye udlulise amazi enduduzo wathi ubemhlonipha kakhulu uMsimang.

OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wakuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma uthi ugqigqa izinkantolo nje futhi usevela kwikhomishini kaZondo yingenxa yetulo elidala lokuthi asuswe ebuholini kuhulumeni.UZuma udalule lokhu ngoMsombuluko ngesikhathi eqala ukufakaza kwikhomishi ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Ngesikhathi eqala ukufakaza uZuma, ummeli wakhe u-Adv Muzi Sikhakhane uqale wacacisa ngokubhalela kwakhe ikhomishini eyicela ukuthi imthumelele imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi avele. USikhakhane uveze ukuthi akukho kuhle ukuthi kule khomishini kunabantu asebebukwa njengamaqhawe abanye babukwa njengabasolwa ekubeni yasungulelwa ukuthi ithole iqiniso ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.Eseqala ukufakaza uZuma uqale ngokundlalela umlando ngokuhlaselwa kwakhe athi kwaqala ngonyaka ka-1990 lapho athola khona umbiko wokuthi kunabahlela ukuthi lidicilelwe phansi igama lakhe ngaphambi kwengqungquthela ye-ANC. Uthe ngemuva kokwenza uphenyo lwakhe wathola ukuthi ababefuna ukumhlasela babehlongoza ukwenza lokhu ngoba ‘wayazi lukhulu’ uZuma ngohulumeni wobandlululo. Uthe ngokombiko we-UN bangu-43% abesifazane abasemkhakheni wezolimo emhlabeni kodwa uma sekubhekwa ngasohlangothini lobunini bomhlaba kuvela ukuthi balima emhlabeni ongewona owabo.“Abesifazane kulo mkhakha yibona abahlakula amasimu, batshale imbewu baphinde bavune kodwa umsebenzi wabo awuqhakambiswa. IZIGAMEKO zokugwazana kwabafundi esikoleni samabanga aphezulu KwaMakhutha zenze ukuthi uvalwe khona umkhankaso wokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane izolo.Umcimbi wokuvala imigubho yalo mkhankaso wenziwe yiMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, okhale ngezigameko ezimbi ezenzeke kule ndawo. Yize singashiwongo ngegama isikole kodwa yiseMasakhane High lapho kuke kwagwazana abafundi ababili bashona ngo-Agasti. Imeya iveze izibalo zezigameko ezahlukene ezibikwe esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaMakhutha kusukela ngoSepthemba, ezinye zazo ezinyukile. Ithe ikhethe ukuvala umkhankaso KwaMakhutha ukukhuza umhlola wezigameko ezingezinhle. UNkk Gumede uqale waveza izibalo zokudlwengulwa ezibikwe esiteshini samaphoyisa, athe ngoSeptemba bayisihlanu abadlwenguliwe, ngo-Okthoba bayisishiyagalombili kwathi ngoNovemba balishumi.“Okubi ngalezi zibalo ziyenyuka kunokuba zehle. Lapha sikhuluma ngezibalo zezigameko ezibikiwe kuphela. Kungenzeka ukuthi baningi abanye abadlwenguliwe kodwa bangabika,” echaza.UNkk Gumede uveze nezibalo zokugqekezwa kwemizi ngoSepthemba ezibe u-39, zaba wu-35 ngo-Okthoba zaba u-44 ngoNovemba. Emacaleni okushaya ngoSeptemba abe ngu-34, ngo-Okthoba aba u-28 kwathi ngoNovemba awu-35. Imeya igxeke ukwanda kwamathaveni angekho emthethweni, ethe anomthelela ekubhebhethekiseni ubugebengu. Ezibalweni zamathaveni atholakele engenawo amalayisensi agcine engu-28 ngoNovemba, eqale engu-19 ngoSepthemba. Kwababulewe izibalo zikhomba ukuthi babe yisikhombisa ngoSepthemba bagcina beyisishiyagalolunye ngoNovemba. Kulo mcimbi imeya ibuye yapha ngamaphasela okudla imindeni edonsa kanzima. Ithembise ukuthi nezaguga zizothola izipho ungakashayi uKhisimusi.OnguSihlalo wekomiti leCommunity Service kuMasipala weTheku, uNkk Zama Sokhabase ugcizelele ukuthi kuvalwa kuphela imigubho ehambisana nomkhankaso kodwa abesifazane nezingane kumele bavikelwe unyaka wonke. Naye ukhale ngesigameko sokugwazana kwabafundi esikoleni, athe yikho okwenze ukuthi bawuvale KwaMakhutha umkhankaso. Umkhankaso wavulwa yimeya eSankotshe nakhona okuthiwa bekwande izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabadala. Emcimbini wayizolo kunandise umculi wowokholo uDumi Mkokstad obehambisana noBetusile. Njengoba ngempelasonto ezayo kulindeleke kubhaliselwe ukuvota okokugcina ngaphambi kokhetho oluzoba ngoMeyi, enye intsha ayikaqinisekisi ukuthi izobhalisa.UMsawenkosi Dlamini (23), ofunda e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, uthe yayisimvumela iminyaka yokuthi avote okhethweni loHulumeni baseKhaya ngo-2016 kodwa wangavota.“Ngathola sekuzovotwa ukuthi kwakufanele ngibhalisele ukuvota eThekwini lapho sengihlala khona uma ngifunda. Nokho angizisolanga ngokungavoti ngoba akukho obekungigqugquzela. Namanje akukho okungenza ngilangazelele ukuvota ngoba akekho nosigqugquzelayo emanyuvesi,” echaza.Uthe uzoya kobhalisela ukuvota ngesonto elizayo kodwa usazibuza ukuthi yiliphi iqembu elifanelwe yivoti lakhe. Ukhala ngokuthi amaqembu akhona awagculisi futhi alikho iqiniso.“Ngibona sengathi uma ngivota ngizobe ngifaka imali ephaketheni lomuntu. Sishoda ngabaholi abakhathalele abantu ngokweqiniso. Ikusasa lezwe lincike evotini lami,” kusho uZanele.Yize ethe ngeke adalule ukuthi uzovotela liphi iqembu, uthe alikhethile ulibona likhathalele imfundo yabamnyama.UZama Khumalo (19), oyokwenza unyaka wokuqala eDurban University of Technology, uthe akanawo umfutho wokuvota futhi akakabhalisi. Uthe ubengazi nokuthi kuyabhaliswa ngesonto elizayo.Uveze ukuthi abazali bakhe abamkhuthaza ukuthi avote ngoba bamtshela ngesimo abaphuma kuso ngezikhathi zobandlululo.“Kunzima kithina esingazazi lezo zikhathi ngoba esikubona manje yinkohlakalo kuphela. Baningi abantu esibabona besahlupheka nezingane zifunda kanzima kodwa sitshelwa ukuthi sikhululekile. Ngicabanga ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki kusamele aqinise ekushintsheni imiqondo yethu ukuthi yiluphi ushintsho esizolubona uma sivota. Ngo-2014 yayingu-33% intsha eneminyaka ewu-18 no-19 eyavota okhethweni luka­zwelonke. Egqugquzela iqembu lakhe ukuthi livote eThekwini, uMntwana wakwaPhindangene, uMangosuthu Buthelezi, ukuphawulile lokhu kungabi nkamunkamu kwentsha ekuvoteni.
